title: TBS Guide route and loot research

primary_source.title: Golden Sun Syndicate walkthrough
primary_source.author: ikillkenny (Golden Sun Anonymous), hosted by Golden Sun Syndicate

content_notice: Original concise factual instructions; no source prose or artwork copied. Canonical names and existing draft facts resolve noted inconsistencies.
integration_status: Canonical authored wording for location references, live actions, native hints and quest log. tools/build_adventure_walkthrough.py generates all three content headers; adventure_state.json owns detection and selection rules. Full automatic step progression remains incomplete.
coverage_notice: All 44 numbered route sections are represented, including optional backtracking and Crossbone Isle. This does not prove every chest or every detailed puzzle solution is covered.

steps.text: Follow the evacuation route north to meet Garet, then go west, climb the ladder and cross the bridge.
At the far west end, turn back southeast. Warn the injured man, then return east toward the river scene.
After the rescue plan begins, go south beneath the bridge, climb back up and cross it to the Town Plaza.
Find help among the men south in the plaza, then return to Felix's riverbank.
Finish the current scenes. Continue when control returns.
Accept the Sol Sanctum mission, return east past your home, then approach the guarded Sanctum entrance again to proceed.
Take the right stepping stones. Loop left, cross the tunnel and use the middle route in the next room.
Open the chest, use its gem on the statue, cross the far-left stones and push the marked statue.
Maze route: left, north, east, north, west, then second narrow left passage for a small gem. Backtrack to skipped left hall.
Move the far-left ledge statue. Place a gem in its figure and enter the right-hand door.
In the sun room, put both outer statues on their switches before moving the central statue. Then place the statues in the other room on their switches.
Optionally take the bottom Psynergy Stone. Return to Kraden and open the wall crack.
Follow the available platforms to collect the stars. Return to the central platform between trips and finish any conversations before continuing.
Finish the chamber conversation, then use Retreat when control returns.
Speak with the Great Healer, then go to the town gate. Finish the conversations and receive any offered items before leaving.
On the world map, approach the Djinni south of Vale and finish the conversation.
Follow the dirt path southeast to Vault.
Finish the caravan conversation outside Vault, then enter town.

sections.title: Vault

steps.text: Go to the northwest hilltop house. Speak with the person inside and agree to help.
At the inn, question the downstairs patrons, then confront the two men upstairs. Leave when they evade you and follow Ivan's plan to corner one.
Finish the conversation upstairs, then climb the inn's outside ladder and enter the opening in the roof.
Move the box blocking the cellar door, jump the gap and speak to the bound worker.
Finish the cellar conversations and check the chest.
Return to the northwest hilltop house and speak with the mayor. Heal at the inn before leaving.

source_issues: The page recommends a Mercury Summon in this early fight; omitted because that advice is inconsistent with the party available at this point.
Original Vault scripts identify the bound person as the roof worker; Ivan must join before accompanying the inn investigation.

sections.title: On The Road To Bilibin

steps.text: Finish helping Ivan in Vault before continuing to the cave.
From Vault, cross the eastern bridge and turn north to the cave. Approach the leaf-covered stump and finish the conversation. Move the stump, then use Whirlwind at the cave entrance.
Inside, follow the upper route, cross a stepping stone, descend and take the stairs and doors toward the traveler and ledge Djinn.
Push the stump between the ledges, backtrack to the water crossing, then take the southern route through doorways and stepping stones to the next stump.
Move the upper pillar right, hop to the broad stump below and Move it right into the gap. Move the upper pillar back left and cross the upper ledges to the chest.
Return to the water ledge, use the stump bridge and fight the Djinni on the ledge.
Push the blocking stump into the water, cross it, and follow the stairs and bridge out of the cave.

source_issues: Native virtual chest101 at27,8 is Lucky MedalF4F by the upper-pillar puzzle. PowerBreadF28 at28/entrance5 is the separate Vale hidden cave, not the Goma route.

steps.text: Rest at the inn and check the weapon shop.

Go to the fence in the northeast of Bilibin. Follow its logs around to the leaf-covered entrance on the western side of town. Face the leaves and cast Whirlwind, then go downstairs. Use Move to shift the statue blocking the passage, walk past it and approach the Djinni.
Return to town and visit Lord McCoy's chambers in the northern castle. Learn where the barricade is weak, then leave toward Kolima Forest.
At the barricade, Move the far-left box to clear the route northeast.
Go to the tree-house on the eastern side of Kolima. Walk around to its hidden rear entrance and go inside. Follow the basement passage to the Djinni and approach it.
Finish exploring Kolima, then enter Kolima Forest.

sections.title: Kolima Forest

steps.text: In the forest, cross the first log path. Push the blocking log west and continue north around it. On the next screen push the second blocker left and follow the northern path.
Push the next vertical log west, horizontal down, vertical east, bottom log down, horizontal up, then vertical west into water. Cross and head east.
At the switch, lower the water, push the upper vertical log left, refill and cross.
Climb Tret's front vine. Work upward using outside branches. Avoid jumping back onto used leaves.
Check the northern stone and the chest on the inner ledge.
Take the first north branch and approach the Djinni. Return to check the northeastern chest.
Drop one floor. Reach the southern room and jump middle, right, middle to fall into the basement.
Finish the battle and conversation, then use Retreat.

source_issues: The page states the Healing Ring restores 70 HP and wears out quickly; both mechanics are omitted pending review.
Native room45 provider102 payload300000/flag350 is a Psynergy Stone; source Psy Crystal corrected. HealingRing100F5B and Nut101F5C are ordinary item chests.

sections.title: Heading North

steps.text: Use Move to rescue the stranded tree-person at Bilibin Barricade before giving Tret the water.
Return west to Bilibin to heal, then leave northwest. Cross two bridges, follow the white dirt path to Bilibin Cave and enter over the waterfall.
At the first fork go right, descend the stairs, cross the ice-cylinder room and exit near Imil. Continue north and west to town.

source_issues: Hard Nut timing follows the supplied draft: rescue before the cure, reward afterward.

steps.text: Enter the first house and open its chest. Finish receiving the item, then speak with the ill old man.
Rest at the inn, visit the church, then return to the old couple's house. Finish the conversations before leaving.
Before leaving, move the snowman left from the bridge's right-hand stairs. Cross the bridge and enter the first ice opening.
Slide in this order: right, up, left, up, left, up, right, up, left, up, right, up.
Approach the Djinni in the ice cave. Leave town to the east when ready.

sections.title: Mercury Lighthouse

steps.text: Climb the stairs and speak with the woman. Move the statue, use Ply on the door and continue through the passage.
Finish the conversation with Mia before continuing.
Roll the first pipe right. Push the discolored pipe left. Move the long-path statue to the west square.
Use Ply on the goddess. Follow the water-hop route.
Check the chest, then enter the third waterfall from the left and open the chest beyond it.
In the north pipe room push both horizontal pipes up, the vertical left. Cross the refilled room.
Use the pipes to shift the water statue until it drops. Return and set it on the switch.

text: Move the statue and connect the pipe.

steps.text: Use Ply on the waterfall statue. After the story scene fill the Empty Bottle at the fountain for Hermes' Water.

source_issues: The page mislabels Sleet as Wind; Sleet is Mercury.
If the Empty Bottle was missed or dropped, the page points to a chest in the old people's home.

Cross-check26October2026: source fourth waterfall from left is wrong. Golden Sun Universe identifies third from left/fourth from right; original room56 event53 at16,7 is in the third of six repeated wall bays and leads to55/10. No continuous traversal proof.

Missing inventory does not mean an unopened chest. Golden Sun Universe Hermes' Water/Mercury Lighthouse pages document artifact recovery for sold/discarded Empty Bottle or Hermes' Water. Inventory and pickup predicates unchanged.

sections.title: Back to Kolima Forest

steps.text: Leave the lighthouse, return through Imil and Bilibin Cave, cross the barricade and go back to Tret in Kolima Forest.
Give Tret Hermes' Water. After the forest scene, use Retreat and return to Kolima.
Visit Lord McCoy in Bilibin. Choose one reward chest, then leave town and travel east past Kolima to the bridge. The guard now lets you cross.

steps.item: Vial; Potion; Psy Crystal; Water of Life
steps.text: Choose one of the four reward chests.

source_issues: Source misspells Vial; canonical item name used.

sections.title: Fuchin Temple

steps.text: Mind Read the temple monk, speak with him, then visit the waterfall monk.
Check the barrels behind the monk, then cross the stones and enter the waterfall grotto.
Check the eastern chest if desired, then return to the southern bank and ride the left log north.
From one square below the western ledge top, go right, north, then right. On the eastern ledge, walk left along its north edge to the doorway, then go north.
In the lower hall, take the central northern passage. Hop across the water and open the chest.
Take the west doorway from the stone room. In the upper log room, ride the southern vertical log west, follow the bank north and open the chest.
Follow logs around the west wall and spikes to the northern door. Continue to the Dragon's Eye and use it on the dragon statue.
Approach the Djinni on the eastern ledge. Return to the temple and speak with the monk when finished.

source_issues: The page is unsure whether the Dragon's Eye is required; it mislabels Zephyr as Mercury (Zephyr is Jupiter).

sections.title: Mogall Forest

steps.text: Use Force to follow the stump creature. The route can also be memorized without Force.
Use Force on the first stump. At the next, do not. Push logs right, down, left, up and cross.
Follow the creature east, south, west. Use Force on stumps. Move the rock into the hole, lower logs and continue.
Take the southwest grass route and defeat the Djinn before crossing onward.
At three stumps, use Force on the middle one. Move the blocked log's rock into its hole, shift the log east and cross. Continue around the mini-stumps and save before the next encounter.
Follow the creature south. Heal and save before continuing. Finish any battle rewards before leaving the forest south toward Xian.

source_issues: Unnamed forest Djinni identified as Quartz using the supplied draft.

sections.title: Xian

steps.text: If you have Force, you can try the optional stump exercise at the temple.
Heal at the inn. To reach the eastern cliff Djinn, bring Frost. Guide the wandering girl to one tile below and one tile left of the top-right corner, freeze the pillar, then cross to the cliff.
Approach the Djinni on the eastern cliff, then explore the nearby building.
Stand beside the outlined stump without touching its line and use Force to open the door. Speak with Feizhi and her father.
After the conversation, visit the northwest weapon shop and leave town.

source_issues: The source's NPC-position instruction for reaching Mist is unusually specific; preserve its stated tile offset, but verify in-game if it fails.

steps.text: From Xian, go north across the forest and bridges to the small island.
Explore the small island and recruit the Djinni when you encounter it.
Return south past the forest, then cross northwest to Alpine Crossing and continue north to Altin.
Move the statue west of town with Move and enter the cave.
Open the cave chest.
Rest at the inn, descend the ladder outside, and follow the creature into the cave.
Follow it through the cave and challenge the statue after sliding down the cliff.
Take the reward, then use Frost on the puddle below and cross the new ice pillar to leave.
In eastern Altin, descend the two ladders into the mine.

sections.title: Altin Peak

steps.text: Follow the mine tracks, switch the route east of the first cart, and ride to the statue.
Defeat it and collect its reward.
Freeze cave puddles to make pillars. Use switches and carts to reach the statue by the lake and the Djinni ledge.
Move the eastern stump left, freeze its neighboring puddle and change the northern switch. Cross to the cart. Ride again from its eastern stop and approach the Djinni.
At the falling-rock sign, face the stump and use Force. Descend through the opened track and hole.
Follow the lower cavern to the paved area. Finish the battle and receiving conversations, then open the chest behind the statue. Finish receiving its item before returning to the exit.
Revisit the earlier Lift-blocked mine chest after obtaining Lift, then leave for Lama Temple.

source_issues: The source misspells Spritz; cart-junction instructions remain condensed.

steps.text: Visit the northwestern temple and speak with Master Hama.
Jump the stream east of town and cast Reveal to uncover a chest.
Open the revealed chest.
Return east to Alpine Crossing. Reveal the apparent dead end, enter the hidden door and use Lift on the blocking boulder.
After freeing Hsu, return to Lama Temple and leave southwest toward the desert.

sections.title: Lamakan Desert

steps.text: Use Reveal on safe stone circles to find water pools. Avoid suspicious circles until revealed because some trigger traps.
Search the southern stones on the open screen.
At the eastern wall, go one stone group south, then return west to the half-circle. Use Reveal and approach the Djinni.
Cross the sandfalls, then Reveal the dead-end waterfall to find the cave passage.
Cross the western sandfalls and Reveal the far western waterfall. Heal and save before continuing through the doorway.
Collect the boss reward.
Explore the island north of the desert and recruit the Djinni when you encounter it.

source_issues: The page describes the first desert water point as a pool and later calls another a water hole; it does not clearly distinguish them.

steps.text: Upgrade equipment, then climb to Hammet's castle; Ivan can persuade the guards to admit you.
Speak with Lady Lana, then talk to everyone across every floor of the inn before leaving town.
After the tourist scene, cross the repaired bridge north of Kalay and continue back to Vault.

sections.title: Vault... Again

steps.text: Ring the tower bell to move the Djinni east, then Reveal the ladder among the graves near the dog.
Check the chest near the cave entrance.
Move the torch onto the flame tile; Whirlwind the leaves, then use Frost on every water drop except the easternmost and cross the ice pillars.
Flip the water switch, then light the second flame tile to open the gate. Continue down the newly drained ladder.
Climb from the lower room and approach the Djinni.
Use Retreat to return to the cave entrance and leave Vault.

source_issues: The chest beyond the Whirlwind door is described only as an attack-boosting item; the page does not name it.

sections.title: Bilibin Cave... Again

steps.text: Use Douse on the fire above the ice pillars in the normal cave route. Backtrack outside and use Growth to reach the alternate entrance.
Near the opened chest on the alternate route, use Reveal on the suspicious stones. Enter the hidden doorway and Douse the fire in the small chamber.

steps.item: Water of Life and Psy Crystal
steps.text: Return to the ice pillars after both fires are out. Cross onto the western ledge and take its northern doorway. Open both chests, then return through the southern door.
If you need more Hermes' Water, return to the restored fountain with an Empty Bottle.
Return west to Vale.

source_issues: The page says Herme's Water can be obtained again but gives no route or trigger details.

steps.text: Use Whirlwind on the bush behind Vale's shop and enter the cave for the chest.
From Vault, return west to Vale; Lift the rock by the western fence and Reveal the hidden stepping stone in the cave.
Push the box into the water, roll the log east, then lower the side logs and slide down the western notch to move the cross-log north.
After the ladder north of the door, open the chest before approaching the Djinni.
Chase the fleeing Djinni down the cliff, use Halt, and approach it.
Return to Kalay Docks by the southern route around the caves.

sections.title: Kalay Docks

steps.evidence_note: Original ticket callback rom_7c6bac851C compares/deducts600;15 original choice/funds cases, verify_kalay_ship.py. Source walkthrough800 corrected.
steps.text: Buy the Tolbi ticket at the north building's counter for 600 coins, then board at the western docks.
Find the Captain's Anchor Charm on the ship's observation deck and return it to the captain below.
Reach the crew quarters behind the tour guide and descend the hidden stairs to start the voyage.
When a rower can no longer continue, find a passenger willing to replace them and return to the crew quarters.
For the optional early Crossbone Island route, choose passengers in this order: green-skirted woman, blonde woman, older man, then the merchant away from the stairs. Put weaker rowers on the right.
Respond to calls from the deck and finish any battles before continuing the voyage.
Collect the victory reward.

source_issues: The source misspells Kraken as 'Krarken' in an inserted note and later mistakenly says 'Kraden'; the encounter is Kraken.

sections.title: Tolbi Docks

steps.text: Move the northwestern boxes into a jump path from the ledge by the house to the lower ledge.
Jump across the boxes and climb to the chest.
Leave the docks and enter Tolbi.

source_issues: The page gives no box-by-box order for the dock puzzle.

sections.title: Tolbi

steps.text: Buy equipment in the southwest shop. Sleep in Babi's palace by speaking to the desk attendant and facing a bed.
Optional: spend Lucky Medals at the fountain for variable equipment prizes.
Use tickets at the northeast inn slot machine. Rewards depend on the rings and stops.
Leave through the south gate and circle around the cliff to the vine. Use Growth on it. Use Frost on the pool. Return inside town and cross the ice pillar.
Cross the ice pillar and approach the Djinni.
Leave Tolbi and head toward Altmiller Cave.

source_issues: The fountain and slot-machine rewards are variable; the page lists odds, not a guaranteed prize.

steps.text: From Tolbi, follow the northwest dirt road and cross the western bridge.
Explore the forest beyond the western bridge and recruit the Djinni when you encounter it.
Return northeast across the bridge, follow the coast east to northern Kalay Docks, then walk down to the Djinni.
Approach the Djinni at the docks, then return north across the bridge toward the cave.

sections.title: Altmiller Cave

steps.text: Use Reveal for light in dark passages. At the first rock blockage, go left, up one tile, right, then up the stairs.
Speak with the invisible man and finish the conversation. Continue past him into the lower caves.
For the Djinni, roll the vertical log right, lower horizontal log up; Frost the puddle, return vertical left, then lower both horizontal logs.
Approach the Djinni after completing the log crossing.

Use Reveal on the rocks. Examine the leftmost rock, then the rightmost rock. Wait for the wheel to stop, then examine the rock matching its flashing top color. Repeat until the passage opens, then enter it.
In the small supply chamber, walk north to the chest and open it. Finish receiving its item before leaving through the southern doorway.
Use Reveal on the return route, give Babi the Draught, then Retreat and travel southwest to Tolbi.

source_issues: The color-wheel instruction is described informally; it does not state a color sequence beyond matching the top color.

Sources disagree on fixed match count (Syndicate says3, Golden Sun Universe/RetroMaggedon say2). Stop at the actual opening rather than instructing an extra turn. Match the flashing top color only after the wheel stops; no audio dependence.

sections.title: Colosso

steps.text: Rest at the palace and enter the stadium. For course one, position Garet, Mia and Ivan at successive stages. Give Ivan Growth.
Before round one, have Garet move the stump left and Ivan grow the vine. With Isaac, cross the gap, move the blocking stump, push the pipe west, and climb the vine.
Check the north path and log section for chests.
For round two, have Mia freeze the western puddle during preparation. As Isaac, open the chest, cross the ice pillar and climb the wall. Shift the logs left and then right to continue.
For the final round, use Garet's Move, Mia's Frost, and Ivan's Halt if available. Avoid the optional chest, cross the moving pillars, then push the three logs up and the vertical log into the water.
Finish the tournament and speak with Babi. Inspect his desk before leaving.
Take Babi's requested gear.

source_issues: Some course chests are unnamed; verify prize labels and unclear log directions.

steps.text: Reach Gondowan Cave, lift the rock, and take the cave route toward Lunpa.
Check the cave chests.
Move the log and tree to clear the path. At Lunpa's gate, use Frost on the puddle.
Pass Kalay and Vault, then enter Lunpa through the cave.
Bring Cloak Ball from Babi's desk and Catch Beads before entering the fortress.
At the north gate, use Reveal on the rock and Frost on the puddle. Hop across before Reveal fades, then search the sparkle for the entrance.

steps.item: Water of Life; Smoke Bomb; Lucky Medal; Antidote; 44 Coins; Elixir; Psynergy Stone
steps.text: Search the hidden area.

Equip Cloak Ball and use Cloak in shadow to pass the guards. In the key chamber, equip Catch Beads and Catch the key through the bars. Clear vines with Whirlwind, then use Reveal and examine the hidden switch or doorway.
Open the long-box room chest.
Finish the battle rewards and conversations, then leave by the same route. Decline Bunza's wagon if you want to return to the fortress and speak with Donpa.
Speak with Donpa, then enter the room behind his wife and approach the Djinni.

sections.title: Kalay... Again

steps.text: Rest in Kalay and speak with Bunza.
Optional: search the castle's west hall.

In the western waterfall cavern, push the statue north and west to stop the water. Climb down the eastern ladder and Frost the remaining drop. Climb back up and cross the ice pillar to the chest. Return to the connecting passage for the eastern waterfall cavern.
Push the eastern cavern's statue west into the waterfall. Climb down into the drained cavern, cross to the other ladder and approach the Djinni.
Backtrack through Gondowan Cave, then rest in Tolbi.

source_issues: Four tunnel chests are mentioned but their contents are unnamed.

steps.text: Cross the southern bridge from Tolbi and head southeast to Suhalla.
Visit the red-roofed house southwest of town and speak with Iodem about water and sandstorms.
Equip Douse before entering Suhalla Desert.
Equip the Douse Drop if Douse is missing. Keep Douse ready for the storms. Reveal can expose route clues.
Go west and south to the first storm. Use Douse when caught. At the first three-way fork take the easternmost path. In the next area choose the middle storm path.
Follow the northern passage to the ridge. Use Reveal to expose the stump on the western ledge. Cross it and climb down to the Djinni.
Finish the Djinni encounter, then climb back up. Reveal the stump again if needed and retrace the crossing east.

Leave the colored storm for the optional island route. Heal and save before descending the main ladder. Use Douse when the giant storm catches you. Finish the rewards, then follow the path south and out of the desert.
Take the stone south of the storm route.
Heal with the minister beyond the north gate.
On the first cliff screen, slide down to the chest. Open it and climb the vines back to the upper path before continuing east.
At the slide cluster, take the third slope from the left and approach the Djinni. Climb east afterward and leave northeast.
Fight the Djinni on the slide route.
Continue northeast toward Venus Lighthouse.
Use Reveal on the tree-floor door, descend and open the chest.
Return north, take the eastern branch and cross the stepping stones to the chest.
Open the chest in the hidden entrance room.
On the west branch, Carry the block, Reveal the hidden stairs beyond the electricity, and inspect the statue's tile pattern. Retreat when ready.
Return to the world map and go north, then west, toward Lalivero.
Rest at the northwest inn and shop southeast.
Search the northeast rooftop jar.
Hop across the rooftops and climb the vine to reach the Djinni.
Climb the southwest house's ladder, hop onto the town wall and follow it counterclockwise over the town gate. Descend the vine to the chest.
Leave town north for Babi's Lighthouse.

sections.title: Babi Lighthouse

steps.text: First inspect the Venus statue route in Venus Lighthouse, Part 1.

Use the western ladder beside the statue and Move the left pillar left. Return outside, uncover the eastern ladder and descend from there. Move the right pillar left, cross the gap and climb the northern ladder. Grow the vine, climb it and use the slide route.
Fight the Djinni in the crevice route.

From the upper crevice room, take the nearest upper-left slide to reach the workers. Finish the conversation, use Reveal at the sign and press the hidden switch. Go through the opened door and descend to Temple Ruins.

In the first shared pillar room, Move the right pillar down one space and two spaces right. Return to the upper ledge and hop across to the eastern ledge. Leave through the southern doorway, then follow the lit stepping stones along the route selected at the Venus Lighthouse statue.

supplemental_sources: Original native providers, doors and callback measurements: local/guide-mode/finish-game-20261026.

sections.title: Venus Lighthouse, Part 2

steps.text: West branch: place the pillars at their western track ends. Whirlwind the bushes, drop the extra pillar and push it along its winding track. Restore the upper crossing. Carry two cubes onto the right white platform. Cross the raised left platform.
Reveal the chest in the western statue side room.

South branch: weight the water-drop plates with filled pillars. Douse the movable pillar, then Frost its water from above. Cross east. Arrange the statues: red/blue above, gold centered, green/violet below.
Heal before taking the lobby stone.

Bridge the Carry gap, cross the sand and enter the rightmost fall. Complete the first straight conduit and activate the switch. Cross the new sand lane and move the pillars for the next crossing. Middle conduit: right-down northwest, left-up southwest, horizontal northeast. Weight the western platform with two cubes and activate the next switch. Use the left sand lane and cross the sand maze. Final conduit: right-down northwest, up-right below it, left-down southeast of that, vertical far southeast. Press the final switch. Cross the right sand lane to the northeast stairs.
Reveal the southern branch's side-room chest. Search behind the right sandfall later.
Before the final slide, finish side trips, heal and save separately. After sliding down, Retreat cannot return you to the earlier route.

source_issues: Original source diagram unavailable; exact conduit instructions now cross-checked with independent Venus Lighthouse descriptions and original hole/actor metadata. Physical pushing and current animation await gameplay confirmation.
supplemental_sources: Original native providers, doors and callback measurements: local/guide-mode/finish-game-20261026.

steps.text: Retreat from Venus Lighthouse to Suhalla Desert; Carry is needed for Crossbone Island.
Save separately in the desert if you want a return point.
Reveal the stump, cross to the cave, and take its northeast route. Enter the pink tornado without Dousing it to reach Crossbone Island.

sections.title: Crossbone Island

steps.text: Grow and climb the plants along the western cliff. At the top, the middle and right slides lead to chests. For the cave, take the left slide and use Whirlwind on the shrub below. Enter, follow the hall north and descend the stairs.

steps.item: 111 Coins; Nut; Hard Nut; Antidote; Lucky Medal
steps.text: For the southwest chest, Move the entry stump right and cross west. Reset the room before the southeast chest route, which uses the entry stump left. For the northwest chest, reset again, Move the entry stump right and follow the western stones north. Move the next stump right and continue to the chest. The northern chest is reached around the outer ledge.

steps.item: Elixir; 222 Coins; Lucky Pepper; Mystery Blade
steps.text: Floor 2: take the first three chests by walking north from the entrance, then around the blocks counterclockwise and up the eastern edge. For the northwest chest, move the northern horizontal log up, the northeast vertical log left, then both eastern horizontal logs up. Finish with the northwest vertical log right and horizontal log up. The exit is south along the west edge.

steps.item: 333 Coins; Fairy Ring; Cookie; Smoke Bomb; Psy Crystal
steps.text: Floor 3: Catch the four blue gems from their surrounding platforms and use them on the four blue doors along the upper ledge. After leaving the rightmost chest doorway, go south to the circular stepping-stone formation. Reveal its hidden red gem, Catch it, then descend the western stepping stones and jump west to the red door.

steps.item: 444 Coins; Sleep Bomb; Storm Gear; Psy Crystal
steps.text: Floor 4 needs the Cloak Ball. Halt the moving statues to pass them, use Cloak while in shadow, and use Reveal to expose the chest paths. The first two statues east of the entrance guard the northern chests. The western narrow passage leads toward the exit and its nearby chest.

steps.item: 555 Coins; Lucky Medal; Ninja Garb; Potion
steps.text: Floor 5: the northeast chest is reached around the upper ledge. For the other chests, arrange the logs with the water drained, climb out and use the switch to flood the pool. Reset between the northern and southwestern chest arrangements. The northwest chest is beside the landing used for the exit route. Follow that ledge south to leave.

Floor 6: set the two entry stumps as a crossing, then follow the northern ledge to the stump beside a slide. Push it down and follow. Frost the puddle east of the ladder, climb and cross north. Follow the Djinni through the upper ledges, return over the entry stumps, and cast Halt on the Djinni from the south across the intervening block before approaching it.

steps.item: Elixir; 666 Coins; Demon Axe; Water of Life; Bane (Venus Djinni)
steps.text: After the Djinni route, move the chest-bearing stump north to prepare the central crossing. Use the ladders, move the western stump and its lower log east, then cross to the middle chest. For the southern chest, position the lower stump from its north side so you keep an escape route. Move it south and west afterward to open the floor exit.

steps.item: Lucky Medal; Psy Crystal; Wicked Mace; 777 Coins; Water of Life
steps.text: Floor 7 needs the Carry Stone. Reset the first block between the northeast, raised middle and western chest routes. Carry it north for the northeast chest, or west and then north for the raised middle chest. For the western chest, drop it off the upper ledge and position it as a stepping stone. Jump onto the hidden ledge directly below the chest beside the exit. A second block on the southern path makes the exit crossing.

Floor 8: Frost the puddle beneath the white platform, climb north and follow the cliff south to the eastern chest. Freeze the next puddle and return by the ladder for the upper-middle chest. Reset before the lower-middle chest route so the white-platform puddle starts unfrozen.

steps.item: Smoke Bomb; 888 Coins; Cleric's Ring; Potion
steps.text: For the lower-middle chest, freeze only the puddle south of the east-cliff ladder. Circle the logs, move the dark rock east and return toward the dragon. Lower the horizontal log before freezing the platform puddle. Let the dragon melt the obstructing ice. Cross and refreeze from the north, then continue through the ladders and second log. The northwest chest is reached by crossing another puddle before freezing it. Slide down and leave south afterward.

steps.item: 999 Coins; Sleep Bomb; Water of Life; Muramasa; Psy Crystal
steps.text: Floor 9: the eastern island chest uses the western horizontal log north, upper vertical log east, eastern horizontal log north and southeast vertical log west. Reset for the northern lake chest. Use the lower vertical log to reach the chest between the lakes, then rearrange the western lake logs for the northwest chest. Ride the final vertical log east and follow the ledge south to leave.
At the western dock, heal and save before exploring the ship. Finish any battle and reward conversation, then open the chest at the north end of the ship.

steps.item: 8,000 XP; 9,000 Coins; Water of Life; Demon Mail
steps.text: Finish any receiving conversation and leave inventory space before continuing.

source_issues: Numbering follows source puzzle floors. Chest routes are condensed; not exhaustive.

Review26October2026: first-floor northwest route clarified to move the second stump right, not north; entry-vine count removed in favor of actual successive plants. Original providers/terrain and independent route descriptions cross-checked; physical traversal unconfirmed.

sections.title: Venus Lighthouse, Part 3

steps.text: Return through Babi Lighthouse and the ruins if you left for a side trip. At the room before the final slide, heal and make a separate save before descending.
Check supplies, equipment and Djinn before the slide. After arriving at the top, keep the earlier save and finish the conversations before crossing the blue platforms to the central stairs.
Climb the central stairs when ready. Finish the current battles and conversations. Guidance continues when field control returns.

source_issues: Original room187 has no initial Psynergy Stone/chest match. Refill advice belongs to the pre-slide room186/17; no top-floor reward or completion inferred.

steps.text: Finish the conversation in the house, then leave. Finish the conversation outside and receive the offered item before continuing to the dock.
Speak with the soldier at the guarded northwest building and enter. Follow the lower ledge west, then go north along the dock.
At the northern end of the dock, select the Black Orb in Items and choose Use. Finish the conversations and let the sequence finish.

tolbi-docks-house-chest-route.objective: Leave the house for the docks chest route
tolbi-docks-house-chest-route.text: Leave this building and return to the docks. Go to the northwestern house and arrange its boxes into the ledge-crossing route.

tolbi-docks-potion.objective: Move the northwestern boxes into a jumping path
tolbi-docks-potion.text: By the northwestern house, move the boxes into a jump path between the upper and lower ledges. Jump across from the ledge by the house. Climb to the chest and open it. Retrace the box crossing to return.

tolbi-docks-house-return.objective: Leave this house and return to the docks
tolbi-docks-house-return.text: Leave the house by the doorway you entered. Once outside, leave the docks for Tolbi when ready.

tolbi-ember-from-building.objective: Return to the streets for the southern cliff route
tolbi-ember-from-building.text: Leave this building and return to Tolbi. The Djinni route starts outside the south gate, around the cliff by the vine and pool.

tolbi-ember-freeze-pool.objective: Freeze the pool beside the grown vine
tolbi-ember-freeze-pool.text: Use Frost on the pool beside the vine. Return inside Tolbi and approach the ice pillar from the town side. Cross to the Djinni.

tolbi-ember-ice-crossing.objective: Cross the ice pillar from inside Tolbi
tolbi-ember-ice-crossing.text: Return inside Tolbi and cross the ice pillar to the Djinni. Approach it to finish the encounter.

tolbi-ember.objective: Grow the vine and freeze the pool outside the south gate
tolbi-ember.text: Leave through the south gate and circle around the cliff to the vine. Use Growth on it. Freeze the pool with Frost. Return inside Tolbi and cross the ice pillar to the Djinni.

colosso-finished.objective: Finish the tournament scenes and return to Babi
colosso-finished.text: Finish the tournament and following conversations. Return to Babi at the palace. Rest and finish receiving the offered items before leaving.

colosso-course-one.objective: Cross the first course and defeat your opponent
colosso-course-one.text: Before the race, have Garet move the stump left and Ivan use Growth on the vine. As Isaac, cross the gap and move the blocking stump. Push the pipe west, then climb the vine. Check the equipment chests along the route before entering the arena. Finish the duel to continue.

colosso-course-two.objective: Freeze the western pool and cross the second course
colosso-course-two.text: Have Mia freeze the western pool before Isaac starts. Open the chest along the route and cross the ice pillar. Climb the wall. Shift the logs left, then right, to continue to the arena. Finish the duel before the next round.

colosso-course-three.objective: Cross the moving pillars and push the logs into place
colosso-course-three.text: Use your companions' Move, Frost and Halt assistance where available. Cross the moving pillars. Push the three logs north, then push the vertical log into the water. Continue to the arena and finish the final duel.

colosso-prepare.objective: Choose where each companion will help on the course
colosso-prepare.text: Speak with the stadium staff and choose your companions' course positions. For the first round, assign Garet, Mia and Ivan to the successive help stages. Check that Ivan has Growth before positioning him. Finish the preparation conversations before starting Isaac's run.

tolbi-cloak-loan.text: Speak with Babi in his room. Inspect his desk and finish the conversation about the loan. Finish receiving the item before setting out for Lunpa.

tolbi-lunpa.text: Leave Tolbi and travel back toward Kalay, then north toward Lunpa. Bring the Cloak Ball.

tolbi-suhalla.objective: Leave Tolbi and travel south toward Suhalla
tolbi-suhalla.text: Rest and buy supplies in Tolbi if needed. Cross the southern bridge and follow the southeastern route to Suhalla. Speak with Iodem in town before entering the desert.

ending-black-orb.objective: Finish the conversation and leave the house
ending-black-orb.text: Finish the conversation with Iodem. Leave the house and finish the conversation outside. Leave inventory space and finish receiving the offered item before going to the dock.

ending-northern-dock.objective: Enter the guarded northwest building and continue to the dock
ending-northern-dock.text: Leave the house and go to the guarded building in northwest Lalivero. Speak with the soldier and enter. Follow the lower ledge west, then walk north along the dock.

ending-raise-ship.objective: Use the Black Orb at the dock
ending-raise-ship.text: Walk to the northern end of the dock. Open Items, select the Black Orb and choose Use. Finish the resulting conversations and let the sequence finish.

venus-finale-aftermath.text: Finish the current conversations. Guidance resumes when control returns.

venus-finale-ready.objective: Cross the blue platforms and climb the central stairs
venus-finale-ready.text: Finish the current conversations. When control returns, check the party and keep the earlier separate save. Cross the blue platforms, climb the central stairs and approach the upper platform.

venus-first-outer-door.objective: Enter the lighthouse through its northern doorway
venus-first-outer-door.text: Follow the outside path to the lighthouse entrance on the north side of this area and go inside.

venus-first-foyer-north.objective: Cross the entrance hall to the northern doorway
venus-first-foyer-north.text: Walk north through this entrance hall and take the doorway at the far end. It leads to the branching room with the patterned floor.

venus-first-reveal-carry-stairs.objective: Reveal the staircase in the western half of the branching room
venus-first-reveal-carry-stairs.text: Look for the tree pattern on the floor in the western half of this room. Stand beside it and cast Reveal to expose a staircase. Descend that staircase and open the chest beside its landing.

venus-first-carry-vault.objective: Open the chest beside the hidden-stair landing
venus-first-carry-vault.text: Open the chest immediately south of the stair landing in this small chamber. Leave room in a party member's inventory, then finish receiving the item.

venus-first-vault-return.objective: Return up the stairs north of the chest
venus-first-vault-return.text: Finish receiving the item. Walk north to the staircase beside the chest and go back up to the branching room.

venus-first-wrong-vault-approach.objective: Use the hidden staircase in the upper branching room
venus-first-wrong-vault-approach.text: Take the stairs at the southern end of this passage back to the upper branching room. Cast Reveal on its tree-patterned floor and descend the hidden staircase to reach the chest.

venus-first-hub-northwest.objective: Take the northwestern doorway to the Carry blocks
venus-first-hub-northwest.text: Return to the western side of the branching room and take its northern doorway. Continue into the larger room with the two small Carry blocks.

venus-first-northern-carry-block.objective: Carry the northern small block south to clear the upper route
venus-first-northern-carry-block.text: Equip the Carry Stone on a party member. Use Carry to move the northern small block south into the space just below its starting row. This clears the upper route. Take the left of the two doorways in the northern wall.

venus-first-left-northern-door.objective: Take the left of the two northern doorways
venus-first-left-northern-door.text: Cross to the upper ledge and take the left of the two doorways in the northern wall. That doorway leads along the western branch toward the route statue.

venus-first-reveal-statue-stairs.objective: Reveal the hidden stairs by the southwest wall
venus-first-reveal-statue-stairs.text: Beyond the electrical barrier, use Reveal to find the hidden staircase near the southwest wall. Descend it to the connecting passage below.

venus-first-statue-connecting-hall.objective: Follow the passage north to the statue chamber
venus-first-statue-connecting-hall.text: Follow this straight passage north and take the doorway at its end. It leads to the chamber with the large route statue.

venus-first-inspect-route-statue.objective: Inspect the large statue on the eastern side
venus-first-inspect-route-statue.text: Go to the large statue toward the eastern side of this chamber and inspect it. Finish the conversation and note the path pattern it shows you before leaving.

venus-first-eastern-room-return.objective: Return south, then take the western branch
venus-first-eastern-room-return.text: Take the southern doorway back to the room with the small Carry blocks. Use the left of its two northern doorways for the western branch toward the route statue.

venus-first-vault-corridor-north.objective: Follow this passage north to the Carry-block room
venus-first-vault-corridor-north.text: Walk north through this passage and take the doorway at the top. It returns to the eastern side of the room with the small Carry blocks.

venus-first-carry.objective: Reveal the tree-floor door and open the chest

venus-first-lucky-cap.objective: Cross the eastern stepping stones to the chest
venus-first-lucky-cap.text: In the branching room, take the eastern path and hop across the stepping stones. Open the chest on the eastern ledge, just south of the staircase. Return across the stones when finished.

venus-first-finished.text: After inspecting the statue's route pattern, use Retreat. Return to the world map and go north, then west toward Lalivero.

venus-first-carry-block.objective: Carry the block on the west branch
venus-first-carry-block.text: Equip the Carry Stone and use Carry to move the blocking stone on the west branch. Continue beyond the electrical barrier.

venus-first-statue.objective: Reveal the hidden stairs and inspect the statue's pattern
venus-first-statue.text: Use Reveal beyond the electrical barrier to find the hidden stairs. Inspect the statue and remember the route pattern for the passage from Babi's Lighthouse.

lalivero-torch-shop-ladder.objective: Climb the equipment shop ladder for the Djinni
lalivero-torch-shop-ladder.text: Climb the ladder at the back of this equipment shop to reach its roof. Hop right from that roof onto the town wall.

lalivero-torch-building-return.objective: Go to the southeastern equipment shop for the Djinni
lalivero-torch-building-return.text: Leave this building and enter the equipment shop in southeast Lalivero. Its back ladder leads to the rooftop route.

lalivero-torch-east-roof.objective: Follow the wall north, then west to the Djinni
lalivero-torch-east-roof.text: Hop right onto the town wall and follow it north around the northeast corner, then west. Go slightly past the roof with the Djinni and jump onto the next building. Hop back to the Djinni's building, climb its vine and approach the Djinni.

lalivero-torch-west-roof.objective: Follow the town wall around to the northern rooftops
lalivero-torch-west-roof.text: Hop onto the town wall. Follow it counterclockwise above the town gate and around to the northeast corner, then west. Pass the Djinni's roof, hop onto the next building and jump back to its building. Climb the vine and approach the Djinni.

lalivero-water-life-shop-ladder.objective: Climb the shop ladder for the northeast rooftop jar
lalivero-water-life-shop-ladder.text: Climb the ladder at the back of this equipment shop. The route to the northeast rooftop jar continues from the roof.

lalivero-water-life-east-roof.objective: Cross the roofs south of the northeast corner
lalivero-water-life-east-roof.text: Hop right onto the town wall and follow it north to the northeast corner. Jump onto the building just south of that corner, cross to the next roof and climb its vine. Search the jar on the left. Return down the vine and across the roofs to the wall afterward.

lalivero-water-life-west-roof.objective: Follow the wall to the northeast rooftop jar
lalivero-water-life-west-roof.text: Follow the town wall counterclockwise above the town gate and around to the northeast corner. Jump onto the building just south of the corner, cross to the next roof and climb its vine. Search the jar on the left, then return to the wall.

lalivero-warrior-helm-house-ladder.objective: Climb this house ladder to the chest route
lalivero-warrior-helm-house-ladder.text: Climb the ladder in this southwest house to reach the roof. Hop onto the town wall. The chest route follows it around the south side of town.

lalivero-warrior-helm-west-roof.objective: Follow the wall over the town gate and descend the vine
lalivero-warrior-helm-west-roof.text: Hop onto the town wall and follow it counterclockwise, crossing above the town gate. Look for the vine leading down to the chest near the southeast corner. Descend the vine and open the chest, then return to the wall.

lalivero-warrior-helm-east-roof.objective: Follow the southern wall to the chest vine
lalivero-warrior-helm-east-roof.text: Hop right onto the town wall. Follow the wall around toward the south side of town and look for the vine leading down to the chest near the southeast corner. Descend to the chest, open it and climb back up to the wall.

lalivero-torch.objective: Cross the rooftops and climb the vine to the Djinni
lalivero-torch.text: Enter the equipment shop in southeast Lalivero and climb the ladder at its back. The rooftop route to the Djinni begins from that shop roof.

lalivero-water-life.text: Enter the southeastern equipment shop and climb its back ladder. From its roof, you can follow the town wall to the northeast rooftop jar.

lalivero-warrior-helm.objective: Use the southwest house for the wall-side chest route
lalivero-warrior-helm.text: Enter the house in southwest Lalivero and climb its ladder to the roof. From there, the town wall leads around to the chest near the southeastern corner.

lalivero-babi-lighthouse.objective: Rest and leave north for Babi's Lighthouse
lalivero-babi-lighthouse.text: Rest at the northwest inn and shop southeast if needed. Leave town north for Babi's Lighthouse.

babi-statue-prerequisite.objective: Inspect the Venus Lighthouse statue first
babi-statue-prerequisite.text: Return to Venus Lighthouse. Reveal the hidden stairs beyond the electrical barrier and inspect the statue's route pattern, then return here.

babi-luff.objective: Approach the Djinni on the isolated ledge
babi-luff.text: From the upper rim, use the slide that lands on the isolated Djinni ledge. Approach the Djinni and finish the battle. Slide off its ledge when done, circle the gap on the lower floor and climb the northern stairs.

babi-hidden-door.objective: Reveal the switch beside the blocked door
babi-hidden-door.text: At the blocked door, cast Reveal where the sign stands. Press the switch it uncovers and finish the conversations before continuing through the doorway.

babi-opened-door-north.objective: Go north through the opened doorway
babi-opened-door-north.text: Finish the conversation at the door. Go through the opened doorway to the north and descend into Temple Ruins.

babi-construction-chest.objective: Move and Carry the small block to reach the upper chest
babi-construction-chest.text: Climb the construction ladders to the small gray block on the eastern ledge. Push it two spaces left, use Move to shift it north once, then use Carry to drop it left into the gap. Jump across to the chest and open it. Hop back and follow the construction path north afterward.

babi-approach-north.text: Climb the construction ladders and follow the orange planks north to the lighthouse work area. Continue onto the next screen.

babi-growth-ledge.objective: Grow the vine and enter from the upper ledge
babi-growth-ledge.text: Use Growth on the plant beside this upper ledge and climb it. Follow the ledge to its slide, then enter the doorway below.

babi-outside-first-ladder.objective: Use the western ladder beside the statue
babi-outside-first-ladder.text: Descend the western ladder next to the statue. In the chamber below, use Move on the left pillar to shift it left. Return up the ladder, uncover the eastern ladder by moving its statue, and descend on that side.

babi-outside-return-door.objective: Use the opened entrance to reach the hidden door
babi-outside-return-door.text: Enter the lighthouse and descend to the chamber with the hidden door. Reveal its switch again if the door has closed, then go north into the ruins.

babi-upper-crevice-room.objective: Use the upper-left slide to reach the workers
babi-upper-crevice-room.text: From the upper room, take the nearest slide on the upper-left side. It drops through the floors to the chamber with the workers and blocked door. Finish their conversation there, then Reveal the switch at the sign.

babi-upper-drop.objective: Slide down to the isolated ledge
babi-upper-drop.text: Use the slide into the opening below. After landing, finish the ledge encounter if you are collecting Djinn, then slide down again to the lower floor.

babi-middle-stairs.objective: Circle the gap and climb the northern stairs
babi-middle-stairs.text: Follow the floor around the gap and take the doorway to the north. Climb the stairs to the upper room. From there, use the nearest upper-left slide to fall down to the chamber with the workers and blocked door.

babi-door-connecting-hall.objective: Take the northern doorway to the workers
babi-door-connecting-hall.text: Follow this short passage north to the chamber with the workers and large blocked door. Finish their conversation before using Reveal at the sign.

babi-temple-ruins.objective: Continue through Temple Ruins and follow the Venus statue pattern
babi-temple-ruins.text: Finish Iodem's scene and enter Temple Ruins. Arrange the pillars and follow the route pattern shown by the Venus Lighthouse statue.

babi-log-route.objective: Follow the orange logs north and descend the ladders
babi-log-route.text: Follow the construction path north to the lighthouse work area. Use the western ladder beside the statue to descend, then take the underground route toward the upper ledge and slides.

venus-tunnel-oracle.objective: Reveal the chest beside the statue
venus-tunnel-oracle.text: In this side room, climb the stairs south of the statue to reach its ledge. Cast Reveal beside the statue and open the hidden chest. Leave by the northern doorway when finished.

venus-tunnel-asura.objective: Reveal the chest at the end of this side chamber
venus-tunnel-asura.text: Walk east from the doorway into the side chamber. Cast Reveal at the apparent dead end and open the hidden chest. Return through the doorway in the northwest of this chamber.

venus-tunnel-oracle-approach.objective: Take the southwestern doorway for the side-room chest
venus-tunnel-oracle-approach.text: From this junction, take the southwestern doorway into the small side room. There, climb the stairs south of the statue and use Reveal to uncover the chest.

venus-tunnel-asura-approach.objective: Take the side doorway near the southeast of this room
venus-tunnel-asura-approach.text: Follow the stepping-stone branch toward the doorway near the southeast of this room. Enter the small side chamber and use Reveal at the apparent dead end to find its chest.

venus-statue-red.objective: Put Red on the upper-left square
venus-statue-red.text: Use Move to place the red statue on the upper-left marked square.

venus-statue-blue.objective: Put Blue on the upper-right square
venus-statue-blue.text: Use Move to place the blue statue on the upper-right marked square.

venus-statue-green.objective: Put Green on the lower-left square
venus-statue-green.text: Use Move to place the green statue on the lower-left marked square.

venus-statue-violet.objective: Put Violet on the lower-right square
venus-statue-violet.text: Use Move to place the violet statue on the lower-right marked square.

venus-statue-gold.objective: Put Gold on the middle square
venus-statue-gold.text: Use Move to place the gold statue on the middle marked square.

venus-statue-open-door.objective: Take the opened doorway east of the statues
venus-statue-open-door.text: Cross to the eastern side of the five-statue room and go through the newly opened doorway.

venus-tunnel-fork-south.objective: Take the southeastern doorway to the colored statues
venus-tunnel-fork-south.text: At this junction, the two northern doors lead back to the pillar routes. Take the southeastern doorway to the room with five colored statues.

venus-oracle-chamber-return.objective: Leave the side room through its northern doorway
venus-oracle-chamber-return.text: Walk back north through this side room and take the doorway at the top to return to the junction.

venus-asura-chamber-return.text: Go back to the doorway in the northwest of this chamber. It returns to the stepping-stone passage.

venus-tunnel-to-lighthouse.text: Follow this connecting passage northeast and take the northern doorway to enter Venus Lighthouse.

venus-tunnel-carry-platforms.objective: Carry two blocks onto the right white platform
venus-tunnel-carry-platforms.text: Move the rightmost small block one space left to the ledge above the right white platform. Use Carry to drop it south onto that platform. Drop a second block onto the same right platform to raise the left platform farther. Jump across the raised left platform and take the southern doorway. Leave the third block alone.

venus-tunnel-douse-pillar.objective: Position and fill the pillar for the eastern crossing
venus-tunnel-douse-pillar.text: From the southwestern ledge, face the movable pillar across the narrow gap. Move it south, then work it around to the northeastern end of its track. Cast Douse on the pillar to fill it with water. You will freeze that water from the upper ledge.

venus-tunnel-freeze-pillar.objective: Climb above the filled pillar and use Frost
venus-tunnel-freeze-pillar.text: If the pillar is not at the northeastern end of its track, finish moving it there. Climb the stairs to the upper ledge, face the water on top of the pillar and cast Frost from there. The ice pillar makes the crossing to the eastern ledge.

venus-tunnel-ice-exit.objective: Cross the ice pillar to the eastern ledge
venus-tunnel-ice-exit.text: From the upper ledge, jump across the frozen pillar to the eastern side. Follow that ledge south and go through the doorway to return to the junction.

venus-tunnel-babi-bridge.objective: Cross the pillars to the northern ladder
venus-tunnel-babi-bridge.text: From the eastern ladder, Move the right pillar left and jump across the gap. Follow the ledge north and climb the ladder to the outside vine route. If approaching from the western ladder, shift the left pillar left first and return outside for the eastern ladder.

venus-tunnel-statues.text: In the five-statue room, place red at the upper left and blue at the upper right. Put gold in the middle, green at the lower left and violet at the lower right. Use Move to position each statue on its marked square, then take the doorway that opens to the east.

venus-tunnel-goddess-hall.objective: Leave the statue hall through the southern doorway
venus-tunnel-goddess-hall.text: Walk south past the floor pattern and go through the doorway. The pattern already selected at Venus Lighthouse controls the stepping-stone route farther ahead.

venus-tunnel-first-pillars.objective: Make the crossing to the eastern ledge
venus-tunnel-first-pillars.text: Descend to the pillars and use Move to shift the right pillar down one space, then two spaces right. Climb back to the starting ledge. Hop across the pillars to the eastern ledge and leave through its southern doorway.

venus-tunnel-selected-path.objective: Follow the lit route across the stepping stones
venus-tunnel-selected-path.text: Use the stepping stones along the route lit by the statue pattern. The western branch leads to the pillar rooms. The southern branch leads to the water-weight rooms. If neither crossing exists, return to the statue in the first part of Venus Lighthouse and select a route.

venus-tunnel-west-pillars.objective: Place both pillars at the western end of their tracks
venus-tunnel-west-pillars.text: Go down to the pillars. Move them to the western ends of their marked tracks, one at the northwest corner and the other at the southwest corner. Return to the ledge, jump across them and take the southern doorway.

venus-tunnel-west-brush-pillars.objective: Uncover the extra pillar and build the eastern crossing
venus-tunnel-west-brush-pillars.text: Move the two starting pillars left to reach the bushes on the northwest ledge. Use Whirlwind to uncover the extra pillar. Move it left, push it off the ledge and work it along its winding track to the end beside the slide. Bring the upper-right pillar back east to complete the crossing. Return upstairs, hop across, clear the brush at the southeastern doorway with Whirlwind and go through.

venus-tunnel-west-connecting-hall.objective: Follow the passage south to the Carry platforms
venus-tunnel-west-connecting-hall.text: Walk south through this narrow connecting passage and use the doorway at its end. The next chamber contains the small blocks and white platforms.

venus-tunnel-south-weights.objective: Weight both water-drop plates with filled pillars
venus-tunnel-south-weights.text: Move the first water-filled pillar onto the marked water-drop plate to raise the crossing. Jump to the western ledge and continue south to the second pillar. Fill that pillar with Douse before placing it on its marked plate. Cross the raised pillar and take the doorway onward.

venus-tunnel-south-stepping-stones.objective: Cross to the southern doorway for the Frost-pillar room
venus-tunnel-south-stepping-stones.text: Follow the stepping stones toward the southwestern ledge and take the southern doorway. The side doorway near the southeast leads to a separate Reveal chest room. Return here afterward to continue south.

venus-tunnel-entrance.objective: Arrange the pillars and cross using the statue's pattern
venus-tunnel-entrance.text: Move the pillars to open the tunnel. Follow the crossing pattern shown by the statue in Venus Lighthouse and continue through the ruins.

venus-upper-current-chest.objective: Reach the chest on the southeastern ledge
venus-upper-current-chest.text: From the moving-sand maze, work across the solid ledges toward the southeast. Hold Run during the short current crossings and stop on solid ground between them. Open the chest on the southern ledge, then return toward the eastern doorway for the final conduit puzzle.

venus-upper-scales.objective: Open the chest in this side chamber
venus-upper-scales.text: Walk north from the landing to the chest and open it. Return to the doorway in the south wall when finished.

venus-upper-northwest-chest.objective: Open the chest in the northwest part of the room
venus-upper-northwest-chest.text: Go to the chest in the northwest part of this side room and open it. The doorway in the southeast corner leads back to the northern hall.

venus-northwest-chamber-return.text: Use the doorway in the southeast corner of this side room to return to the hall with three doorways along its north wall.

venus-tunnel-other-branch.objective: Visit both tunnel branches for the remaining side-room chest
venus-tunnel-other-branch.text: The two tunnel branches contain separate hidden chests. To change branches, use the lobby's western stairs and return to the statue in the first part of Venus Lighthouse. Change its lit pattern, then return through Babi Lighthouse and the ruins. Follow the newly lit branch and use Reveal in its statue side room. Return here afterward to continue the main tower.

venus-upper-lobby.objective: Take the northern doorway into the main lighthouse
venus-upper-lobby.text: Heal before taking the Psynergy Stone in this lobby. Go through the northern doorway to enter the hall with three doorways along its north wall. The western stairs are the route out of the tower.

venus-upper-three-door-hall.objective: Use the western doorway to reach the first Carry block
venus-upper-three-door-hall.text: Go to the doorway on the western side of this hall. It leads to a small Carry-block room. Cross that room to begin opening the sandfall route.

venus-upper-single-carry.objective: Drop the small block into the gap on the left
venus-upper-single-carry.text: Push the right-hand small block one space left. Equip the Carry Stone and use Carry to drop it one more space left into the gap. Jump across the block and take the northern doorway.

venus-upper-first-sand-crossing.objective: Run east across the downward-flowing sand
venus-upper-first-sand-crossing.text: Follow the upper path to the sand flowing toward the pit. Enter near its northern edge and hold Run while moving east to the opposite ledge. If you fall, take the recovery stairs and try again. On the far ledge, the southern doorway is a chest detour. The northern stairs continue upward.

venus-upper-fall-recovery.objective: Climb the stairs back to the sand crossing
venus-upper-fall-recovery.text: Follow the recovery passage to its staircase and climb back to the crossing. Approach the sand from the northern end before running east again.

venus-upper-after-first-switch.objective: Use the ladders and cross the newly flowing sand east
venus-upper-after-first-switch.text: Return to the lower level by the southern ladder, then climb the ladder beside the new sandfall. Hold Run and cross east to the upper-right doorway. Enter it to reach the room with two pillars below and another pillar above.

venus-upper-three-pillars.objective: Move the upper pillar west to make a crossing
venus-upper-three-pillars.text: Descend the southeastern ladder. Move the two lower pillars out of the passage they block, then go through that passage to the upper pillar. Push it fully west. Retrace the passage and climb the ladder, then jump across the moved pillar to the northern ledge and climb the stairs.

venus-upper-first.objective: Carry the blocks and follow the lighthouse route upward
venus-upper-first.text: Use Carry on the blocks, move pillars and continue through the lighthouse toward the sandfall rooms.

venus-scales-chamber-return.text: Leave through the doorway in the south wall. It returns to the middle landing in the sandfall room.

venus-upper-first-hidden-sandfall.objective: Push north through the rightmost sandfall
venus-upper-first-hidden-sandfall.text: Walk along the row of small sandfalls and press north into the one farthest right. Pass through its hidden doorway to the stepping-stone room.

venus-upper-stone-and-bridge-room.objective: Follow the stepping stones along the eastern wall
venus-upper-stone-and-bridge-room.text: From the sandfall entrance, jump south along the stones nearest the eastern wall, then west to the southern doorway. This leads through to the first conduit puzzle. When you return by the stairs from the pillar room, descend the ladder, pass under the bridge, climb the opposite ladder and use the stairs toward the next conduit puzzle.

venus-upper-first-switch-room.objective: Step on the purple switch, then take the western stairs
venus-upper-first-switch-room.text: Stand on the purple floor switch to change the sandfall in the hall below. Circle around to the western staircase and descend. Use the ladders in the hall to cross the newly flowing sand east.

venus-upper-first-conduit.objective: Push the straight conduit block into the floor hole
venus-upper-first-conduit.text: Move the block with the straight vertical groove into the empty square in the floor. Wait for the current to reach the door and open it. Use the opened northern doorway to reach the purple switch.

venus-upper-scales-sandfalls.objective: Pass through the left sandfall to continue upward
venus-upper-scales-sandfalls.text: The right-hand sandfall hides a chest chamber. Return here after opening its chest, then press north through the left sandfall. Climb the stairs beyond it to the Carry-platform puzzle.

venus-upper-carry-stair-passage.objective: Climb the northern stairs to the Carry platforms
venus-upper-carry-stair-passage.text: Follow this small passage north and climb its staircase. The room above has white platforms and several small Carry blocks.

venus-upper-under-bridge-passage.objective: Follow the passage to the next conduit room
venus-upper-under-bridge-passage.text: Continue along this short connecting passage and use the doorway at the other end. The next chamber contains several grooved blocks and floor holes.

venus-middle-conduit-northwest.objective: Put the right-and-down bend in the northwest hole
venus-middle-conduit-northwest.text: Find the block with a groove joining its right and bottom edges. Move it into the northwest hole and let it settle. Leave the southeast hole unused for this solution.

venus-middle-conduit-southwest.objective: Put the left-and-up bend in the southwest hole
venus-middle-conduit-southwest.text: Move the block whose groove joins its left and top edges into the southwest hole. The northwest bend should connect down into this piece.

venus-middle-conduit-northeast.objective: Put the horizontal groove in the northeast hole
venus-middle-conduit-northeast.text: Move the block with the straight horizontal groove into the northeast hole. Leave the southeast hole empty. Let the current finish, then go through the opened door.

venus-upper-middle-conduit.objective: Complete the conduit using three of the four holes
venus-upper-middle-conduit.text: Move the block whose groove connects right and down into the northwest hole. Put the block connecting left and up in the southwest hole. Put the straight horizontal block in the northeast hole, leaving the southeast hole empty. Wait for the door to open and go through it.

venus-upper-second-sand-hub.objective: Cross to the northwest ledge and use its southern doorway
venus-upper-second-sand-hub.text: Hop across the nearby pillar to the ledge east of the flowing sand. Go north, cross the sand west and use the pillar to reach the northwest ledge. Take the doorway south from that ledge to the two small sandfalls. Its stairs are a return route, rather than the way to the Carry platforms.

venus-upper-left-river-open.objective: Ride the left sand lane to the southwest stairs
venus-upper-left-river-open.text: After changing the sandfall, follow the newly flowing lane on the left down to the southwest corner. Climb the staircase there and continue toward the moving-sand maze.

venus-upper-right-river-open.objective: Cross the right sand lane to the northeast stairs
venus-upper-right-river-open.text: Leave the central sandfall and run east across the filled sand lane to the northeastern ledge. Climb its stairs and continue up the next stairway toward the final slide.

venus-upper-sandfalls.objective: Follow the sandfall routes and activate the switches
venus-upper-sandfalls.text: Continue through the sandfall rooms. Move the blocking pillars, use Carry where needed and activate the switches to open the route upward.

venus-upper-weighted-platforms.objective: Carry two blocks onto the western white platform
venus-upper-weighted-platforms.text: Move a small Carry block to the ledge above the western white platform and drop it onto the platform with Carry. Repeat with a second block on the same western platform. Jump across the raised eastern platform and go through the doorway on the right.

venus-upper-second-switch.objective: Activate the purple switch after the Carry platforms
venus-upper-second-switch.text: Step on the purple switch, then jump north and take the stairs back down to the sandfall room. Ride the newly flowing left sand lane to the southwest staircase.

venus-upper-final-switch.objective: Activate the switch west of the final conduit exit
venus-upper-final-switch.text: Walk west to the purple switch and step on it. Jump north toward the floating platform, then take the stairs down to the central sandfall. Run across the right sand lane and climb the northeast stairs.

venus-upper-lower-doorways.objective: Follow the lower ledge east toward the final conduit room
venus-upper-lower-doorways.text: The first doorway along this ledge leads through the moving-sand maze. Cross that room toward its eastern exit, then continue east along the lower ledge. Use the last southern doorway for the final conduit puzzle. After solving it, leave through its northern doorway to reach the final purple switch.

venus-upper-floating-platform-hall.objective: Follow the upper ledge toward the final stairway
venus-upper-floating-platform-hall.text: After the final purple switch has opened the sand lane, approach from the northeastern stairs in the sandfall room. Follow the upper ledge toward the stairway beside the floating platform. The stairway leads to the room with the final slide. If you have not reached the moving-sand maze and final conduit yet, return downstairs and use the southwest staircase in the sandfall room first.

venus-upper-sand-maze.objective: Cross the moving-sand maze to the eastern doorway
venus-upper-sand-maze.text: Pause on the solid blocks to line up each crossing. Hold Run while crossing a current so it does not sweep you away from the next ledge. Work toward the eastern side. The chest detour is on the southern ledge. From the eastern ledge, take the doorway into the final conduit room.

venus-final-conduit-northwest.objective: Put the right-and-down bend in the northwest hole
venus-final-conduit-northwest.text: Move the block whose groove joins its right and bottom edges into the northwest hole. Let the block settle before moving the next one.

venus-final-conduit-west-middle.objective: Put the up-and-right bend directly below the northwest piece
venus-final-conduit-west-middle.text: Use the block whose groove joins its top and right edges. Put it in the hole directly south of the northwest piece.

venus-final-conduit-southeast-middle.objective: Put the left-and-down bend in the next southeast hole
venus-final-conduit-southeast-middle.text: Use the block whose groove joins its left and bottom edges. Place it in the hole southeast of the previous bend.

venus-final-conduit-southeast.objective: Put the vertical groove in the far southeast hole
venus-final-conduit-southeast.text: Move the block with the straight vertical groove into the far southeast hole. Let the current finish and go through the northern doorway when it opens.

venus-upper-final-conduit.objective: Connect the four conduit blocks to open the northern door
venus-upper-final-conduit.text: Use the grooves on the blocks to identify them. Place the right-and-down bend in the northwest hole. Put the up-and-right bend in the hole directly below it. Put the left-and-down bend in the next hole southeast of that. Move the straight vertical block to the far southeast hole. Wait for the current to open the door, then go north.

venus-finale-crossbone.objective: Finish the island detour before taking the final slide
venus-finale-crossbone.text: To visit the optional island, leave before taking this slide. Use Retreat, exit the lighthouse and return to Suhalla Desert. Reveal the hidden stump crossing, follow the side cave to the pink tornado and enter it without Douse.

venus-upper-final-slide.objective: Heal and save separately before taking the slide
venus-upper-final-slide.text: Finish any remaining side trips before sliding down: this is the final approach and Retreat will no longer take you back afterward. Heal the party, check equipment and Djinn, and use the Psynergy Stone if needed. Make a separate save, then take the slide to the floating platform when ready.

venus-upper-currents.objective: Arrange the Carry blocks and cross the current rooms
venus-upper-currents.text: Use Carry to place the blocks and change the available crossings. Continue through the current rooms to the floating elevator. Heal and make a separate save before descending.

world-ending-lalivero.text: Return to Lalivero and speak with Iodem.

world-crossbone-late.objective: Return to Suhalla Desert for Crossbone Island
world-crossbone-late.text: Reveal the stump, cross to the cave and follow its northeast route to the pink tornado. Enter it without Dousing it to reach Crossbone Island.

world-venus-return.objective: Return through Babi's Lighthouse and the ruins to Venus Lighthouse
world-venus-return.text: Return to Babi's Lighthouse north of Lalivero. Follow the opened hidden route through the ruins and continue up Venus Lighthouse.

world-lalivero.objective: Travel north, then west toward Lalivero
world-lalivero.text: Leave Venus Lighthouse and travel north, then west toward Lalivero. Rest there before continuing north to Babi's Lighthouse.

world-venus-statue.objective: Return to Venus Lighthouse and inspect its statue
world-venus-statue.text: Return to Venus Lighthouse. Carry the block on the west branch, Reveal the hidden stairs and inspect the statue's route pattern.

world-venus-first.objective: Continue through Suhalla Gate toward Venus Lighthouse
world-venus-first.text: Continue through Suhalla Gate and leave northeast toward Venus Lighthouse. Reveal the tree-floor door to find the Carry Stone.

world-lunpa.text: Return through Kalay and head north toward Lunpa. Bring the Cloak Ball.

world-suhalla.objective: Follow the southern route to Suhalla
world-suhalla.text: Travel south toward Suhalla and prepare for the desert crossing.

tolbi-colosso.objective: Rest at the palace, then enter the stadium
tolbi-colosso.text: Finish the scenes with Babi and return to Tolbi. Rest at the palace. Enter the stadium and speak with the staff to prepare for Colosso.

tolbi-altmiller.text: Buy equipment and rest if needed. Leave Tolbi and follow the northwest dirt road. Cross the western bridge toward Altmiller Cave.

altmiller-draught-return-supply.objective: Leave the supply room through its southern doorway
altmiller-draught-return-supply.text: Finish receiving the chest item. Take the southern doorway back to the colored-rock chamber.

altmiller-draught-return-rocks.objective: Take the southern stairs back to the log room
altmiller-draught-return-rocks.text: Leave the colored-rock chamber by its southern stairs. Retrace the lower log room to the western doorway.

altmiller-draught-return-logs.text: Return through the western doorway to the long dark passage. Use Reveal to light the return route.

altmiller-draught-return-hall.objective: Follow the dark passage east to the stairs
altmiller-draught-return-hall.text: Follow the passage east to the stairs near its northeastern end. Climb them back to the lighted log chamber.

altmiller-draught-return-squall.objective: Take the western stairs back toward Babi
altmiller-draught-return-squall.text: Follow the lower passage west to its stairs. Go back through the connecting chamber toward the invisible man.

altmiller-draught-return-connector.text: Take the northwestern doorway back to the passage with the invisible man. Use Reveal if you need light.

altmiller-return-babi.objective: Return to the invisible man and give him the Draught
altmiller-return-babi.text: Return to the invisible man in the first dark passage. Use the Mystic Draught from your party's items and finish the conversation.

altmiller-return-tolbi.objective: Finish the scenes, then Retreat and return to Tolbi
altmiller-return-tolbi.text: Let the conversation and following scenes finish. When control returns, use Retreat to leave Altmiller Cave. Travel southwest to Tolbi and rest before Colosso.

altmiller-draught-not-held.objective: Check the Draught and return to Babi
altmiller-draught-not-held.text: Check your party's items for the Mystic Draught from the opened supply chest. Return to Babi and give it to him.

altmiller-entrance-stair-passage.objective: Continue north up the connecting stairs
altmiller-entrance-stair-passage.text: Follow this short passage north to its staircase. Climb into the next dark corridor.

altmiller-first-rocks.objective: Reveal the dark passage and pass the first rocks
altmiller-first-rocks.text: Use Reveal to light the dark passage. Follow the hall around its bend. At the first rock blockage, go left, north one square and right. Take the stairs beyond the rocks.

altmiller-meet-babi.text: Use Reveal to see the dark passage. At the fork, follow the left branch and speak with the invisible man. Finish the conversation, then take the staircase beyond him.
