altmiller-squall-after-frost.text: Go around the lower rocks and roll the vertical log left. Get behind the western upright log to push the lower horizontal log south. Lower the upper horizontal log and cross to the Djinni.

altmiller-squall.objective: Arrange the logs and freeze the pool to reach the Djinni
altmiller-squall.text: Roll the vertical log right. Push the lower horizontal log north. Freeze the middle pool with Frost. Go around the rocks below and roll the vertical log back left. From behind the western upright log, push the lower horizontal log south. Lower the upper horizontal log as well, then approach the Djinni.

altmiller-lower-log-route.objective: Cross the lower log chamber to the northern doorway
altmiller-lower-log-route.text: Push the first vertical log left. Go southwest to the stairs, then follow the wall counterclockwise and slide down. Push the next vertical log left and take the northern doorway.

altmiller-rocks-start.text: Use Reveal to see the rocks' colors. Examine the leftmost rock to begin the puzzle.

altmiller-rocks-rightmost.text: Examine the rightmost rock. Let the wheel finish turning before choosing the next rock.

altmiller-rocks-match.objective: Match the color at the top of the wheel
altmiller-rocks-match.text: Wait for the wheel to stop. Examine the rock matching the flashing color at the top. Repeat after each spin until the passage opens.

altmiller-rocks-opened.objective: Enter the passage behind the rocks
altmiller-rocks-opened.text: Let the opening scene finish. Enter the passage behind the rocks to reach the small supply room.

altmiller-supply-chest.objective: Open the chest in the north of this supply room
altmiller-supply-chest.text: Walk north through this small room and open the chest. Finish receiving the item before returning through the southern doorway.

altmiller-colored-rocks.objective: Reveal the colors and solve the five-rock puzzle
altmiller-colored-rocks.text: Use Reveal on the five rocks. Examine the leftmost rock, then the rightmost rock. Wait for the wheel to stop, then examine the rock matching its flashing top color. Repeat until the passage opens, then go through it.

altmiller-after-babi-corridor.text: Take the staircase beyond the invisible man. Follow the next passage west and south, then use the right fork to continue deeper.

altmiller-middle-connector.objective: Follow the passage to the southeastern stairs
altmiller-middle-connector.text: Follow the passage around its bend to the southeastern stairs. They lead into the lighted log chamber.

altmiller-squall-room-main.objective: Continue east through the lighted log chamber
altmiller-squall-room-main.text: Follow the main route east. Shift any blocking logs aside and push the wooden stump into the gap. Cross to the ledge and use its northeastern doorway.

altmiller-dark-hall-main.objective: Follow the dark passage west to the next stairs
altmiller-dark-hall-main.text: Use Reveal while following the passage south and west. At the rock wall, go south to the gap, then turn north and east back into the hall. Continue west to the stairs.

altmiller-side-chest-f9c.objective: Check the eastern chest in this passage
altmiller-side-chest-f9c.text: Open the chest on the eastern side of this passage, then return to the main route.

altmiller-side-chest-f9d.objective: Check the chest by the northern wall
altmiller-side-chest-f9d.text: While following the dark passage west, check the chest near its northern wall. Return to the passage afterward.

altmiller-lower-caves.text: Use Reveal to light the passages. Continue into the lower caves toward the five colored rocks.

world-tolbi-colosso.objective: Return southwest to Tolbi for Colosso
world-tolbi-colosso.text: Return southwest to Tolbi, rest at Babi's palace and enter the stadium.

world-tolbi-hail.objective: Search the woods beyond Tolbi's western bridge for the Djinni
world-tolbi-hail.text: From Tolbi, follow the northwest road and cross the western bridge. Search the forested area for the Djinni encounter and finish the encounter.

world-tolbi-ground.objective: Follow the northern coast to the other side of Kalay Docks
world-tolbi-ground.text: Return northeast across the bridge and follow the coast east to northern Kalay Docks. Walk down to the Djinni, then return toward Altmiller Cave.

world-altmiller.objective: Follow Tolbi's northwest road to Altmiller Cave
world-altmiller.text: From Tolbi, follow the northwest dirt road across the western bridge and enter Altmiller Cave.

bilibin-return-world.objective: Revisit Bilibin Cave with Douse and Reveal
bilibin-return-world.text: Return north through Bilibin to Bilibin Cave. Bring Douse and Reveal for the fire-and-ice side route. Follow the local directions once inside.

bilibin-return-normal-passage.objective: Take the northern passage to the ice pillars
bilibin-return-normal-passage.text: Follow the main passage north into the ice-pillar cave. Use Douse on the fire above the pillars before trying the upper return route.

bilibin-return-alternate-entry.objective: Return outside for the alternate entrance
bilibin-return-alternate-entry.text: Backtrack outside. Use Growth on the vine to reach the alternate entrance. Inside, find the suspicious stones near the opened chest and use Reveal.

bilibin-return-reveal-door.objective: Reveal the doorway beside the opened chest
bilibin-return-reveal-door.text: Near the opened chest, use Reveal on the suspicious stones. Enter the exposed doorway. Use Douse on the fire in the small room beyond.

bilibin-return-vine.objective: Reach the alternate cave entrance above the vine
bilibin-return-vine.text: If the first cave fire is still burning, enter by the normal passage and Douse it first. Then use Growth on the vine outside to reach the alternate entrance.

bilibin-return-find-alternate.objective: Backtrack outside to the alternate entrance
bilibin-return-find-alternate.text: Take the southwestern doorway back to the main cave passage. Follow it south outside. Use Growth on the vine to reach the alternate entrance, then Reveal the stones near the opened chest.

bilibin-local-return-47.objective: Return through the southwestern cave doorway
bilibin-local-return-47.text: Take the southwestern doorway back to the main passage. Retrace the passage south outside when ready to continue your journey.

bilibin-local-return-48.objective: Return south through the main cave passage
bilibin-local-return-48.text: Follow the main cave passage south to the lower outside exit. Follow your main journey when ready to leave the cave area.

bilibin-local-return-49.objective: Return to the world map from the cave approaches
bilibin-local-return-49.text: Follow the lower path to the southern exit. It returns to the world map so you can continue your main journey.

bilibin-return-first-fire.objective: Douse the fire above the ice pillars
bilibin-return-first-fire.text: Use Douse on the fire above the ice pillars. Backtrack outside and re-enter by the alternate entrance beyond the Growth vine.

bilibin-return-second-fire.objective: Douse the fire in this small chamber
bilibin-return-second-fire.text: Use Douse on the fire in this chamber. Leave through the southern doorway to return to the passage beside the opened chest.

bilibin-return-fire-room-exit.objective: Return south to the main cave passage
bilibin-return-fire-room-exit.text: Take the southern doorway back to the main passage. Return to the ice pillars and use the western ledge for the remaining side-room chests.

bilibin-return-pillar-route.objective: Cross the ice pillars to the western ledge
bilibin-return-pillar-route.text: Return to the ice pillars after both fires are out. Jump onto the western ledge and follow it north to the side-room doorway.

bilibin-return-passage-to-pillars.objective: Return north to the ice-pillar cave
bilibin-return-passage-to-pillars.text: Follow the main passage north to the cave with the ice pillars. Cross to the western ledge and use its northern doorway for the two side-room chests.

bilibin-return-chest-fc6.objective: Open the northern chest in this side room
bilibin-return-chest-fc6.text: Walk north from the entrance and open the northern chest. Finish receiving the item before leaving.

bilibin-return-chest-fc7.objective: Open the southwestern chest in this side room
bilibin-return-chest-fc7.text: Open the other chest, just southwest of the northern one. Finish receiving the item before leaving.

bilibin-return-treasure-exit.objective: Return through the southern side-room door
bilibin-return-treasure-exit.text: Take the southern doorway back to the ice-pillar cave. Retrace the cave route outside when ready to continue your journey.

world-return-vault.objective: Cross the repaired northern bridge and return to Vault
world-return-vault.text: Return to Vault over the repaired bridge north of Kalay. Ring the bell and Reveal the ladder near the graves.

world-return-vale.objective: Return west through Vault to Vale
world-return-vale.text: Return west through Vault to Vale. Lift the rock at the western fence and enter the cave.

world-kalay-lana.objective: Continue toward Kalay and visit the castle
world-kalay-lana.text: Follow the route from Lamakan Desert toward Kalay, then visit the castle and speak with Lady Lana.

world-kalay-inn.objective: Return to Kalay and visit the inn
world-kalay-inn.text: Return to Kalay, speak with the travelers throughout the inn and finish their departure scene.

world-kalay-docks.objective: Take the southern route to Kalay Docks
world-kalay-docks.text: Travel south around the caves to Kalay Docks. Buy the passage ticket and board the ship.

world-lamakan.objective: Travel southwest past Lama Temple to Lamakan Desert
world-lamakan.text: Travel southwest past Lama Temple to Lamakan Desert. Use Reveal on the stone circles to find water.

world-lama.objective: Travel to Lama Temple and enter the northwestern temple
world-lama.text: From Altin, continue toward Lama Temple and speak with Master Hama in the northwestern temple.

world-quartz-return.objective: Return to Mogall Forest and take the southwest grass route
world-quartz-return.text: Return to Mogall Forest, take the southwest grass route and defeat the Djinni there.

world-xian-mist.objective: Cross east to Xian and explore the eastern cliff
world-xian-mist.text: From Mogall Forest, cross east to Xian. Use the water carrier and Frost to make a crossing to the eastern cliff.

world-corona.objective: Go north of Xian across the forest and bridges to the small island
world-corona.text: Search the small island north of Xian for the random Djinni encounter. Win the battle to recruit it.

world-altin.objective: Head north past Xian, then northwest through Alpine Crossing to Altin
world-altin.text: From Xian, follow the northern forest and bridges, then cross northwest to Alpine Crossing and continue north to Altin.

world-mogall.objective: Leave Fuchin Temple and continue to Mogall Forest
world-mogall.text: Leave Fuchin Temple and continue to Mogall Forest. Equip the Orb of Force before following the stump creature.

world-imil-fever.objective: Return north through Bilibin to Imil
world-imil-fever.text: Return to Imil and open the ice route into the cave for the remaining Djinni.

world-mercury-sleet.objective: Return to Mercury Lighthouse for the remaining Djinni
world-mercury-sleet.text: Return to Mercury Lighthouse and search the waterfall route for the remaining Djinni.

world-fuchin.objective: Cross Kolima Bridge and continue to Fuchin Temple
world-fuchin.text: Return to Kolima Bridge, cross it and continue toward Fuchin Temple. Enter the temple to begin its test.

world-barricade-rescue.text: Return to Bilibin Barricade and use Move to rescue the stranded tree-person before giving Tret the water.

world-tret-water.objective: Return through Kolima Forest and use the water on Tret
world-tret-water.text: Return through Kolima Forest to Tret outside the tree and use Hermes' Water from Items.

world-imil-water.objective: Travel north through Bilibin to Imil and Mercury Lighthouse
world-imil-water.text: Travel north through Bilibin to Imil. Bring the Empty Bottle through Mercury Lighthouse and fill it at the restored fountain, then return to Tret.

world-kolima-forest.objective: Travel past Bilibin toward Kolima Forest
world-kolima-forest.text: Follow the route past Bilibin and the barricade toward Kolima Forest. Continue through the forest to the great tree.

mogall-quartz-return.objective: Take the southwest grass route and approach the Djinni
mogall-quartz-return.text: Take the southwest grass route in Mogall Forest. Approach and defeat the Djinni before leaving for Xian.

vault-return-sap.objective: Ring the tower bell, then Reveal the ladder near the graves
vault-return-sap.text: Ring the tower bell to move the Djinni. Near the dog and graves, use Reveal to uncover the cave ladder.

vault-return-leave.objective: Leave Vault and continue west to Vale
vault-return-leave.text: Leave Vault and continue west to Vale for the cave behind the western fence. Return south to Kalay Docks when ready.

vault-return-main-route.text: Return south around the caves to Kalay Docks, then buy the passage ticket and board the ship.

vale-return-kite.objective: Lift the rock by the western fence and enter the cave
vale-return-kite.text: At the western fence, use Lift on the blocking rock. Enter Vale Cave. Use Reveal to uncover the hidden stepping stone.

vale-hidden-cave-return.objective: Clear the vines behind the armory
vale-hidden-cave-return.text: Go behind the armory. Use Whirlwind on the vines. Enter the small cave.

tret-jill-missable-warning.text: Use Move to rescue the stranded tree-person at Bilibin Barricade before giving Tret the water. To skip this optional detour, use Hermes' Water on Tret from Items.

forest-coat-chest.text: Hop across the floating logs to the northeast bank and open the chest. Leave inventory space before opening it.

forest-coat-drain.objective: Drain the pool for the eastern chest
forest-coat-drain.text: Use the switch on the southern bank to lower the water. The eastern chest needs a different log arrangement.

forest-coat-left-horizontal-up.objective: Push the left horizontal log north
forest-coat-left-horizontal-up.text: Stand below the left of the two central horizontal logs and push it north until it stops.

forest-coat-right-horizontal-up.objective: Push the right horizontal log north
forest-coat-right-horizontal-up.text: Stand below the other central horizontal log and push it north until it stops.

forest-coat-upper-vertical-right.objective: Push the upper vertical log east
forest-coat-upper-vertical-right.text: Go around to the west side of the upper vertical log and push it east until it stops.

forest-coat-left-horizontal-down.objective: Push the left horizontal log south
forest-coat-left-horizontal-down.text: Go above the left central horizontal log and push it south until it stops.

forest-coat-lower-vertical-right.objective: Push the lower vertical log east
forest-coat-lower-vertical-right.text: Stand west of the lower vertical log and push it east until it stops.

forest-coat-right-horizontal-down.objective: Push the right horizontal log south
forest-coat-right-horizontal-down.text: Go above the right central horizontal log and push it south until it stops.

forest-coat-lower-vertical-left.objective: Push the lower vertical log west
forest-coat-lower-vertical-left.text: Go around the lower vertical log to its east side and push it west until it stops.

forest-coat-refill.objective: Raise the water for the eastern crossing
forest-coat-refill.text: Return to the southern switch and raise the water. Then cross the floating logs toward the chest on the northeast bank.

forest-coat-reset.objective: Reset the logs for the eastern chest
forest-coat-reset.text: Leave by the southern path and re-enter this clearing to reset the logs, then lower the water again.

forest-coat-return-to-route.objective: Reset the logs for the northern route
forest-coat-return-to-route.text: Return across the logs, leave by the southern path and re-enter this clearing. Then lower the water to arrange the northern crossing.

forest-first-log.objective: Roll the eastern vertical log left
forest-first-log.text: Follow the path around the northeast side of the clearing. Reach the right side of the eastern vertical log and push it left into the water.

forest-first-exit.text: Cross the sunken log, follow the path north and around to the west, then leave through the western forest path.

forest-second-exit.text: Follow the trail opened by the eastern vertical log north, around the bend, and into the next clearing.

forest-second-log.objective: Roll the eastern vertical log left
forest-second-log.text: Follow the path south and west to reach the right side of the eastern vertical log. Push it left until it stops, then follow the northern trail.

forest-third-exit.text: Cross the vertical log that has sunk into place. Follow the forest path onward to the clearing with the water switch.

forest-third-first-left.text: Reach the right side of the vertical log and push it left until it stops.

forest-third-upper-down.objective: Push the upper horizontal log down
forest-third-upper-down.text: Go around to the north side of the upper horizontal log and push it down until it stops.

forest-third-right.text: Go around to the left side of the vertical log. Push it right until it stops.

forest-third-lower-down.objective: Push the lower horizontal log down
forest-third-lower-down.text: Reach the north side of the lower horizontal log and push it down until it stops.

forest-third-upper-up.objective: Push the upper horizontal log up
forest-third-upper-up.text: Go around to the south side of the upper horizontal log and push it back up until it stops.

forest-third-last-left.objective: Push the vertical log into the water
forest-third-last-left.text: Reach the right side of the vertical log and push it left. It can now roll into the water to complete the crossing.

forest-water-cross.objective: Cross the log route toward Tret
forest-water-cross.text: Cross the upper log over the filled pool. Follow the path onward to Tret Tree.

forest-water-refill.text: Finish rolling the upper vertical log left, then return to the switch and refill the pool. Cross the log route once the water has risen.

forest-water-roll.objective: Roll the upper vertical log left
forest-water-roll.text: With the pool drained, reach the right side of the upper vertical log and push it left until it stops. Then return to the switch.

forest-water-drain.text: Operate the switch to drain the pool. Then reach the right side of the upper vertical log and roll it left before refilling.

forest-water-other-layout.objective: Align the upper log for the crossing
forest-water-other-layout.text: Clear the upper vertical log's leftward path and roll it left. Move other logs out of its path if they block it, then refill the pool.

barricade-hard-nut.text: Speak to Jill and finish the conversation. Make inventory space if she asks you to.

barricade-after-cure.text: Finish any ongoing gift conversation, then continue toward Kolima Bridge. You can return to McCoy's palace for his optional reward if you have not claimed it.

barricade-rescue-tree.text: Use Move to rescue the stranded tree-person from the river. Finish the conversation before continuing.

barricade-return-water.text: Finish any rescue scene, then return through Kolima Forest to Tret. Use Hermes' Water on him outside the tree.

barricade-seek-water.text: Return west to Bilibin to rest, then head northwest through Bilibin Cave toward Imil and Mercury Lighthouse. Remember to rescue the tree-person here before curing Tret.

barricade-to-forest.text: Use Move on the far-left barricade box to clear the northeast route. You can explore Kolima or continue into Kolima Forest.

kolima-granite.objective: Enter the eastern tree-house from behind

kolima-after-cure.text: Leave Kolima and continue to Kolima Bridge when you have finished exploring town. If you rescued the tree-person at the barricade before lifting the curse, you can return there for the optional reward.

kolima-return-water.objective: Return to Tret with the water
kolima-return-water.text: Return through Kolima Forest to Tret outside the tree and use Hermes' Water. Rescue the tree-person at Bilibin Barricade first if you want that optional reward.

kolima-seek-water.objective: Seek Hermes' Water north of Bilibin
kolima-seek-water.text: Return through the barricade to Bilibin, then travel north through Bilibin Cave toward Imil and Mercury Lighthouse. Tret needs Hermes' Water to lift the curse.

kolima-to-forest.text: Leave Kolima and enter Kolima Forest. Follow the log crossings to Tret and investigate the curse; Kolima Bridge is not the onward route until the curse is lifted.

kolima-bridge-cross.text: Speak to the bridge builder and finish the repair conversation. Cross the bridge when the route is restored to continue your journey.

kolima-bridge-remedy.text: Return to Tret with Hermes' Water to lift the curse before continuing over Kolima Bridge. If you do not have the water, travel through Bilibin Cave to Imil and Mercury Lighthouse.

kolima-bridge-forest.text: Return toward Kolima Forest and investigate Tret. The bridge becomes the onward route after the curse is lifted.

tret-cured-forest-exit.text: Finish the forest scene, then use Retreat and return to Kolima. McCoy in Bilibin offers an optional reward; Kolima Bridge is now the onward route.

tret-return-outside.objective: Return to Tret outside the tree
tret-return-outside.text: Return outside Tret Tree to Tret in Kolima Forest. Face him and use Hermes' Water from Items.

tret-return-through-forest.text: Follow the forest paths back to Tret Tree. Use Hermes' Water on Tret outside the tree.

tret-seek-remedy.text: Tret is defeated, but the curse remains. Leave the forest and return through Bilibin. Travel north through Bilibin Cave to Imil and Mercury Lighthouse to find Hermes' Water.

mercury-summit-approach.objective: Cross the stepping stones to the central stairs
mercury-summit-approach.text: Heal and save, then cross the stepping stones and climb the central stairs.

mercury-summit-aftermath.text: Finish the conversations before leaving the summit.

mercury-summit-summon.objective: Walk west to bring the elevator up
mercury-summit-summon.text: Walk west toward the elevator and wait for it to rise.

mercury-summit-descend.text: Hop across the western stepping stones and ride the elevator down.

mercury-fill-bottle.objective: Fill the bottle with Hermes' Water
mercury-fill-bottle.text: Return to the fountain at Mercury Lighthouse's base. Face the fountain and use the Empty Bottle to collect Hermes' Water, then return to Tret.

mercury-missing-bottle.objective: Get a bottle for the lighthouse fountain
mercury-missing-bottle.text: Return to the house near Imil's entrance. If its chest is unopened, open it and receive the item. If you sold or discarded the bottle or Hermes' Water, buy it back from an item shop's Artifacts. Bring the Empty Bottle to the restored lighthouse fountain, or return to Tret if you recovered Hermes' Water.

tret-first-floor-vine.text: Follow the outer walkway right, north and left. Climb the vine in the northwest corner.

tret-second-floor-leaves.text: Reach the southern ledge. Hop right across the three bottom leaves, then leave through the eastern door. Avoid landing twice on the same leaf.

tret-third-floor-ring.objective: Open the chest near the inner ledge
tret-third-floor-ring.text: Circle clockwise to the inner ledge and open the nearby chest.

tret-third-floor-stone.objective: Reach the stone on the northern ledge
tret-third-floor-stone.text: From the inner ledge, hop north to the stone, then return toward the northern vine.

tret-third-floor-vine.text: Circle clockwise to the inner ledge, cross the leaf route north and climb the vine.

tret-fourth-east-detour.text: Leave through the southern door. Follow the branch east and climb the vine to the upper branches.

tret-fourth-west-door.text: Follow the walkway counterclockwise to the western door. Outside, take the first branch south and climb its vine.

tret-top-nut.text: Open the chest on the northeastern side of this room.

tret-top-east-return.text: Hop onto an outer leaf, move to a neighboring leaf, then hop back onto the first to drop one floor. Avoid the central leaf. Below, take the western door.

tret-top-back-center.objective: Hop left to the central leaf
tret-top-back-center.text: Hop left onto the central leaf you just used.

tret-top-right-leaf.text: Hop right onto the neighboring leaf, then hop left back to the central leaf.

tret-top-center-approach.objective: Reach the central leaf from the south
tret-top-center-approach.text: Follow the ledge to the southern side. Hop north through the middle to the central leaf, then hop right and back left.

tret-basement-fight.text: Heal and save, then approach the face to the north. Finish the battle and conversation.

tret-branches-djinni.text: From the main branch, take the first branch north. Heal before approaching the Djinni, then return to the main branch and head west into the tree.

tret-branches-top-west.text: Follow your branch back toward the trunk and enter the doorway into the tree.

tret-branches-middle-east.text: Follow the branch east to its vine and climb up. Then return west along the upper main branch.

tret-branches-middle-west.text: Take the first branch south from the doorway and climb the western vine. Follow the upper branch east into the tree.

tret-branches-third-west.text: Follow the higher branch west and enter the doorway into the tree.

tret-branches-lower-east.text: Follow the main branch east to the vine and climb up. Follow the higher branch west into the tree.

tret-climb-to-boss.text: Follow the branches and leaf platforms through the tree. Avoid landing twice on a leaf while climbing. Heal before approaching the face below.

vault-mayor-reward.text: Finish the conversations in the cellar, then return to the northwest hilltop house and speak to the mayor. Leave room in someone's inventory for the offered item.

vault-depart.text: Finish the cellar aftermath. Leave Vault and head east, then north to Goma Cave.

vault-bandit-fight.text: Finish the rescue confrontation and defeat the bandits. Heal as needed, then finish the aftermath and recover the stolen goods.

vault-search-roof.text: Finish the conversation upstairs. Climb the inn's outside ladder and enter the opening in the roof.

vault-corner-thief.text: Approach the two men upstairs with Ivan and finish the resulting conversation.

vault-investigate-inn.text: Question the inn's downstairs patrons, then speak with the two men upstairs. Follow Ivan's plan if they evade you.

vault-meet-ivan.objective: Go to the northwest hilltop house

opening-house-aftermath.text: Finish the conversation at home. Continue when control returns.

opening-battle-aftermath.text: Finish the current scene. Continue when control returns.

opening-after-boulder.text: Continue along the evacuation route away from the river. Finish any conversations along the way.

opening-find-help.objective: Find help in the Town Plaza
opening-find-help.text: Finish the rescue-plan conversation. Go south beneath the bridge, climb back up and cross to the Town Plaza. Speak with the men to the south, then return to Felix's riverbank.

opening-reach-river.objective: Head west, cross the bridge, then go southeast to the river
opening-reach-river.text: Finish speaking with Garet. Head west, climb the ladder and cross the bridge. At the far west end, turn southeast. Speak to the injured man on the way and continue east to the river scene.

opening-meet-garet.text: Follow the evacuation route north to Garet. Speak with him and finish the conversation about leaving his belongings behind.

vale-sanctum-route.text: Finish the planning scene with Kraden. Return east past Isaac's home and approach the guarded route to Sol Sanctum. If the guard stops you, turn away and approach again when he moves.

vale-finish-kraden-plan.text: Stay with Kraden and finish discussing the trip to Sol Sanctum. Speak to him again if the conversation has ended before the group agrees to leave.

vale-meet-kraden.objective: Go to the house west of town
vale-meet-kraden.text: Finish the morning scene, then go west through Vale to Kraden's house. Speak with him and finish the conversation about the strangers and Sol Sanctum.

vale-great-healer.text: Speak to the Great Healer in Vale Sanctum and finish the conversation.

vale-departure-gate.text: Finish the Sanctum conversation, then go to the town gate. Finish the conversations and receive any offered items before leaving.

vale-world-to-goma.text: From Vault, cross the bridge to the east and turn north toward Goma Cave. You can visit the mayor in the northwest hilltop house before leaving.

vale-world-finish-vault.text: Return to Vault and continue Ivan's investigation at the inn.

vale-world-to-vault.objective: Follow the path southeast to Vault
vale-world-to-vault.text: Follow the dirt path southeast to Vault. Finish the conversation outside town, then visit the northwest hilltop house.

bilibin-after-cure.text: If you have not claimed McCoy's optional reward, visit his palace before leaving. Rest and shop as needed, then return toward Kolima and cross Kolima Bridge to continue your journey.

bilibin-return-water.text: Travel back through the barricade and Kolima Forest to Tret with Hermes' Water. Face Tret outside the tree, open Items and use the water on him.

bilibin-seek-water.text: Travel north from Bilibin through Bilibin Cave to Imil and Mercury Lighthouse to find Hermes' Water. Bring it back to Tret to lift the curse.

bilibin-gust-from-building.objective: Return outside to the hidden entrance
bilibin-gust-from-building.text: Leave this building and return to Bilibin's streets. Go to the northeast fence, follow its logs around to the western leaf-covered entrance and use Whirlwind. Descend through that entrance for the route to the Djinni.

bilibin-gust-well-exit.objective: Use the hidden entrance aboveground for the Djinni
bilibin-gust-well-exit.text: Climb out of the well. Go to the northeast fence and follow its logs around to the western leaf-covered entrance. Use Whirlwind on the leaves and descend there.

bilibin-gust-well-side.objective: Return aboveground and take the hidden approach
bilibin-gust-well-side.text: Return through the well passage and climb out. Follow the northeast fence logs around to the western leaf-covered entrance. Cast Whirlwind on the leaves and descend to reach the Djinni's side of the underground chamber.

bilibin-gust-underground.objective: Move the northern statue and cross the ledge
bilibin-gust-underground.text: From the hidden entrance, follow the passage toward the statue in the northern part of the chamber. Use Move to shift it aside, then cross to the Djinni on the northeastern ledge and approach it.

bilibin-gust.text: Go to the fence in the northeast of Bilibin. Follow its logs around to the leaf-covered entrance on the western side of town. Face the leaves and cast Whirlwind, then go downstairs. Use Move on the statue in the northern passage, then cross toward the Djinni on the northeastern ledge.

bilibin-mccoy.text: Rest and shop as needed. Visit Lord McCoy's chambers in the northern palace and finish the conversation about Kolima's curse.

bilibin-barricade.text: Finish the palace conversation, then leave Bilibin toward Kolima Forest. At the barricade, use Move on the far-left box to open the northeast route.

goma-return-vault.text: Return to Vault and help Ivan recover the stolen goods before tackling Goma Cave. Start at the northwest hilltop house if you have not met him.

goma-meet-ivan.text: Climb toward the leaf-covered stump and approach it. Finish the conversation before continuing.

goma-move-entrance-stump.text: Finish the conversation. Use Move to shift the blocking stump, then approach the cave entrance.

goma-clear-entrance.text: Use Ivan's Whirlwind on the vines at the cave entrance, then enter Goma Cave. If returning from inside, the path back to Vault is to the south.

vale-hidden-cave-chest.objective: Open the chest at the north end
vale-hidden-cave-chest.text: Walk north through the short passage and open the chest. Leave inventory space before opening it.

vale-hidden-cave-exit.objective: Leave the cave by the southern passage
vale-hidden-cave-exit.text: Walk south to the cave mouth and return to Vale.

goma-south-cave-route.objective: Cross the stream to the western cave passage
goma-south-cave-route.text: Follow the cave path north from the entrance, cross the stream toward the west bank and continue to the western cave passage. Go through to the room with the traveler and the tall pillar.

goma-first-pillar-right.objective: Push the pillar beside the traveler right
goma-first-pillar-right.text: Go to the tall pillar beside the traveler and push it right until it lines up with the gap between the ledges.

goma-first-pillar-up.objective: Push the traveler-side pillar north into the gap
goma-first-pillar-up.text: After pushing the pillar right, walk around to its south side. Push it north until it fills the gap between the two ledges.

goma-first-pillar.objective: Place the pillar beside the traveler
goma-first-pillar.text: Push the tall pillar beside the traveler right, then north until it stands between the two ledges.

goma-puzzle-return-stairs.objective: Take the staircase east of the western passage
goma-puzzle-return-stairs.text: From the pillar beside the traveler, go west to the staircase just east of the far-west cave passage. Take those stairs into the lower cave. Cross the stream in the south, then follow the path east to the staircase in the southeast corner.

goma-lower-route.objective: Cross the lower cave to the southeastern stairs
goma-lower-route.text: In this lower cave, cross the stream in the south. Follow the path east along the lower side of the room to the staircase in the southeast corner, then climb it to reach the high ledges in the pillar room.

goma-upper-pillar-right.objective: Shift the upper tall pillar right from the high ledges
goma-upper-pillar-right.text: From the high ledges, face the upper tall pillar and cast Move to shift it one space right. Hop onto the ledge it now reaches, above the broad stump.

goma-lower-stump-drop.objective: Push the broad stump below the upper pillar right
goma-lower-stump-drop.text: Hop onto the broad stump below the upper tall pillar. Face right and use Move to push this lower stump into the gap below.

goma-upper-pillar-left.objective: Shift the upper pillar left for the chest crossing
goma-upper-pillar-left.text: Go back to the upper tall pillar above the broad stump you dropped. Cast Move to shift the tall pillar left. Jump across it and the ledges to its right toward the chest on the northeast ledge.

goma-lucky-medal.objective: Cross the upper ledges to the chest
goma-lucky-medal.text: Jump across the upper pillar and the ledges to its right, then open the chest on the northeast ledge.

goma-forge-stairs.objective: Climb the northeastern stairs to the pillar room
goma-forge-stairs.text: Take the stairs in the northeast of this lower cave. They lead back to the eastern ledges of the pillar room, beside the traveler-side pillar you moved earlier.

goma-forge.objective: Cross the traveler-side pillar to the Djinni
goma-forge.text: Go to the pillar beside the traveler that you pushed right and then north. Jump across it to the eastern ledge, approach the Djinni there and finish the battle.

goma-inner-exit.objective: Take the northern stairs west of the Djinni ledge
goma-inner-exit.text: In the pillar room, use the northern staircase immediately west of the eastern Djinni ledge. It leads to the upper cave route. Continue north toward the stump crossing and the cave exit.

goma-placed-exit-28.objective: Cross the fallen stump and go north
goma-placed-exit-28.text: Cross the stump already in the water, then follow the northern passage to the stairs at its end.

goma-exit-28.text: Follow the passage north to the blocking stump. Use Move to push it left into the water, cross it and continue north.

goma-outside.objective: Follow the outside path toward Bilibin
goma-outside.text: Follow the path out of the cave and head right toward Bilibin.

imil-empty-bottle.objective: Open the chest in the first house

imil-healing-visit.objective: Return to the old couple's house
imil-healing-visit.text: Return to the house near the town entrance and finish the conversation inside.

imil-fever-approach.objective: Open the ice route beside the bridge

imil-to-lighthouse.objective: Enter Mercury Lighthouse east of Imil
imil-to-lighthouse.text: Leave Imil to the east and enter Mercury Lighthouse.

mercury-early-church.objective: Return to the church in Imil
mercury-early-church.text: Return to Imil and speak to the apprentice in the church.

mercury-early-house.objective: Return to the sick man in Imil
mercury-early-house.text: Return to the house near Imil's entrance and speak to the sick man.

mercury-meet-mia.text: Climb the stairs and speak to the woman.

mercury-outer-statue.objective: Move the statue aside from the right ledge
mercury-outer-statue.text: Climb the ledge to the right of the statue. Use Move to shift it left.

mercury-free-mia.text: Use Move to shift the blocking statue left and clear the passage.

mercury-sleet-waterfall.text: Enter the third waterfall from the left.

mercury-sleet-approach.objective: Approach the Djinni at the north end
mercury-sleet-approach.text: Head north and approach the Djinni. Defeat it to recruit it.

mercury-sleet-chamber-exit.text: Leave through the southern doorway to return to the waterfall room.

mercury-refill-north.objective: Roll the northern horizontal pipe north
mercury-refill-north.text: Roll the northern horizontal pipe north to connect it.

mercury-refill-south.objective: Roll the other horizontal pipe north
mercury-refill-south.text: Roll the other horizontal pipe north to connect it.

mercury-refill-west.text: Roll the upright pipe left to complete the connection.

mercury-entry-pipe.text: Stand to the left of the upright pipe and roll it right.

mercury-first-pipe-chest.objective: Reach the chest on the eastern ledge
mercury-first-pipe-chest.text: Circle clockwise using the stairs and open the chest on the eastern ledge.

mercury-entry-pipe-reverse.text: Stand to the right of the discolored pipe and roll it left.

mercury-entry-pipe-loop.objective: Circle clockwise to the other side of the pipe
mercury-entry-pipe-loop.text: Follow the clockwise path down and up the staircases to the pipe's right side.

mercury-entry-pipe-south.text: Continue south through the room and take the doorway at the bottom.

mercury-late-pipe-chest.text: Open the chest in the northwest corner.

mercury-late-pipe.text: Stand below the horizontal pipe and roll it north to connect the water flow.

mercury-late-pipe-door.text: Enter the doorway revealed by the connected pipe.

mercury-entrance-guard.objective: Approach the creature blocking the path
mercury-entrance-guard.text: Approach the creature blocking the path and defeat it.

mercury-before-join-east.text: Follow the ledge to the upper-right doorway.

mercury-armor-corridor.text: Cross the ledges east and enter the far-right doorway in the southern wall.

mercury-waterfall-chest.objective: Open the chest at the far right
mercury-waterfall-chest.text: Open the chest at the far right when ready.

mercury-armor-waterfall.text: Enter the third waterfall from the left.

mercury-armor-chest.objective: Open the chest across the water
mercury-armor-chest.text: Hop across the water and open the chest.

mercury-armor-exit.text: Hop back across the water and take the southern doorway.

mercury-water-corridor-center.objective: Take the middle doorway in the north wall
mercury-water-corridor-center.text: Follow the ledge to the middle doorway in the northern wall.

mercury-pool-chest.objective: Open the chest on the western side
mercury-pool-chest.text: Follow the stepping stones to the chest on the western side of the room.

mercury-water-counterclockwise.objective: Hop around the room to the southwest doorway
mercury-water-counterclockwise.text: Follow the stepping stones around the room to the southwest doorway.

mercury-water-west-exit.objective: Take the leftmost doorway in the south wall
mercury-water-west-exit.text: Follow the western ledge south and take the leftmost doorway.

mercury-refill-door.text: Follow the right side of the drained room to the northern doorway.

mercury-refilled-crossing.objective: Cross the refilled pool to its western staircase
mercury-refilled-crossing.text: Hop across the refilled pool to the staircase on its western bank. Take it into the connecting stair hall, then cross that hall to the eastern staircase.

mercury-refilled-stairs.objective: Cross the hall to its eastern staircase
mercury-refilled-stairs.text: From the pool-side entrance, cross the connecting hall east. Climb the staircase on its eastern side to continue toward the drop room.

mercury-drop-ascent.objective: Climb the eastern stairs beyond the floor switch
mercury-drop-ascent.text: In the drop room, walk past the floor switch and climb the stairs on the eastern side. Continue to the higher section of the room.

mercury-before-join-center.text: Take the middle doorway in the north wall.

mercury-before-join-stone.objective: Cross the stepping stone and climb the stairs
mercury-before-join-stone.text: Cross the central stepping stone and climb the stairs.

mercury-joined-hall.objective: Hop past the statue and take the eastern doorway
mercury-joined-hall.text: Hop over the shifted statue and continue through the eastern doorway.

mercury-first-waterfalls-east.text: Walk east past the waterfalls and take the doorway at the far right.

mercury-goddess-slide.objective: Climb the ladder and slide down the chute
mercury-goddess-slide.text: Climb the ladder and slide down the chute to the water below.

mercury-water-ply.objective: Stand on the goddess statue and use Ply
mercury-water-ply.text: Hop onto the goddess statue and use Ply while standing on it.

mercury-water-east.objective: Hop east from the marked square
mercury-water-east.text: Return to the marked square. Hop east across the water, then take the doorway to the north.

mercury-first-statue.objective: Move the statue onto the western floor switch
mercury-first-statue.text: Move the statue along the path onto the western floor switch.

mercury-first-statue-passage.objective: Climb down and follow the lower path west
mercury-first-statue-passage.text: Return along the ledge to the ladder. Climb down, go west and take the northern doorway.

mercury-hidden-statue.text: Go right, descend the ladder, then climb the far-right ladder. Move the statue aside.

mercury-hidden-statue-door.objective: Enter the doorway behind the rightmost statue
mercury-hidden-statue-door.text: Hop across and enter the doorway behind the rightmost statue.

mercury-upper-waterfalls-west.text: Walk west past the waterfalls and take the doorway at the far end.

mercury-upper-stairs.text: Follow the passage south and climb the staircase.

mercury-long-hall.text: Follow the hallway south to its doorway.

mercury-last-waterfall.text: Cross the hallway's gaps and enter the waterfall at the far right.

mercury-last-move.text: Follow the lower and right walls. Move the statue left to clear the approach to the stairs.

mercury-last-stairs.objective: Hop across and climb the stairs
mercury-last-stairs.text: Hop across the cleared approach and climb the northern stairs.

mercury-lift-hall.text: Continue south through the hallway to the next doorway.

mercury-lift-ply.objective: Use Ply on the waterfall statue
mercury-lift-ply.text: Face the statue beside the waterfall and use Ply.

mercury-drop-first-left.objective: Roll the upright pipe fully left
mercury-drop-first-left.text: Roll the upright pipe all the way left.

mercury-drop-first-wait.objective: Wait for the statue to stop
mercury-drop-first-wait.text: Wait for the water to move the statue.

mercury-drop-horizontal-down.text: Roll the horizontal pipe down to limit the upright pipe to one move right.

mercury-drop-one-right.objective: Roll the upright pipe one step right
mercury-drop-one-right.text: Roll the upright pipe right until the horizontal pipe stops it.

mercury-drop-horizontal-up.objective: Move the horizontal pipe out of the way
mercury-drop-horizontal-up.text: Roll the horizontal pipe back up.

mercury-drop-far-right.objective: Roll the upright pipe fully right
mercury-drop-far-right.text: Roll the upright pipe all the way right.

mercury-drop-second-wait.objective: Wait for the statue to stop

mercury-drop-last-left.objective: Roll the upright pipe left again
mercury-drop-last-left.text: Roll the upright pipe left again to drop the statue.

mercury-second-statue.text: Move the fallen statue onto the floor switch.

mercury-second-statue-passage.objective: Take the newly opened northern doorway
mercury-second-statue-passage.text: Return to the northern walkway and enter the doorway above the floor switch.

fuchin-return-to-monk.text: Return to the temple and finish the conversation with Master Nyunpa.

fuchin-unicorn-ring.objective: Search the barrels behind the monk
fuchin-unicorn-ring.text: Search the barrels behind Master Nyunpa before leaving the temple.

fuchin-temple-barrels-return.objective: Check the barrels inside the temple
fuchin-temple-barrels-return.text: Go back into the temple and search the barrels behind Master Nyunpa.

fuchin-reenter-for-extras.objective: Re-enter the grotto through the waterfall
fuchin-reenter-for-extras.text: Return to the waterfall entrance from the temple grounds. Cross the stepping stones and walk through the opening. Inside, follow the optional directions for the remaining chests and Djinn.

fuchin-to-mogall.text: Leave Fuchin Temple and head toward Mogall Forest. Equip the Orb of Force before using Force on its stumps.

fuchin-accept-test.objective: Mind Read the monk and accept the test
fuchin-accept-test.text: Use Mind Read on Master Nyunpa in the temple. Speak with him afterward and agree to take the test.

fuchin-waterfall-monk.objective: Speak with the monk at the waterfall
fuchin-waterfall-monk.text: Go down the stairs outside the temple. Cross the stepping stones to the monk beside the waterfall and speak with him.

fuchin-enter-grotto.text: Cross the stepping stones and walk through the waterfall opening.

fuchin-mimic-return.objective: Return to the first grotto room
fuchin-mimic-return.text: Use Retreat, leave the grotto and re-enter. The right-hand log in the first room leads to the remaining chest.

fuchin-entrance-right-log.objective: Ride the right horizontal log north
fuchin-entrance-right-log.text: Board the right-hand horizontal log from the southern bank and ride it north.

fuchin-entrance-chest.objective: Open the chest on the eastern ledge
fuchin-entrance-chest.text: Step off the right-hand log onto the eastern ledge. Open the chest there. Return to the same log to ride back south.

fuchin-entrance-right-return.objective: Ride the right log back south
fuchin-entrance-right-return.text: Ride the right-hand horizontal log back to the southern bank. Step off there and cross to the left-hand horizontal log for the main route.

fuchin-entrance-east-ride.objective: Ride the western vertical log east
fuchin-entrance-east-ride.text: Board the vertical log by the western doorway and ride it across the room to the east.

fuchin-entrance-east-door.text: Step onto the eastern bank and take the doorway there.

fuchin-entrance-left-log.objective: Ride the left horizontal log north
fuchin-entrance-left-log.text: Board the left-hand horizontal log from the southern bank and ride it north.

fuchin-entrance-north-pass.text: Step off the left-hand log onto the northern bank. Enter the central passage to the stepping-stone room.

fuchin-stepping-stones-west.objective: Cross the stepping stones to the west doorway
fuchin-stepping-stones-west.text: Cross the stumps toward the western side of the room. Take the western stairway into the lower corridor. Leave the northern and eastern doors for later.

fuchin-lower-hall-right.objective: Take the eastern staircase to the statue room
fuchin-lower-hall-right.text: Follow the lower corridor north to its two stairways. Take the eastern stairway to the dragon statue. Face the statue and use the Dragon's Eye from the party's items.

fuchin-lower-hall-left.objective: Take the western staircase to the dark room
fuchin-lower-hall-left.text: Follow the lower corridor north to its two stairways. Take the western stairway into the dark room. The eastern stairway leads to the statue instead.

fuchin-install-eye.objective: Use the Dragon's Eye on the statue
fuchin-install-eye.text: Face the eyeless dragon statue and use the Dragon's Eye from the party's items.

fuchin-right-side-return.text: Use Retreat, then leave the grotto and re-enter through the waterfall. Ride the left-hand horizontal log north in the entrance room. Cross the stepping-stone room to its western stairway. Follow the lower corridor north and take its western stairway back to the dark room.

fuchin-dark-west-stairs.objective: Follow the southern ledge left to the western staircase
fuchin-dark-west-stairs.text: Stay on the southern ledge of the dark room and walk left along it. Take the staircase at the western end to reach the upper log room.

fuchin-dark-left-approach.objective: Walk north along the western ledge
fuchin-dark-left-approach.text: Walk north along the western ledge. Stop one square below its top before turning right.

fuchin-dark-first-east.text: From one square below the top of the western ledge, walk right along the hidden path until it stops.

fuchin-dark-north.text: Walk north along this narrow stretch until it stops.

fuchin-dark-second-east.objective: Cross right onto the eastern ledge
fuchin-dark-second-east.text: Walk right along the final stretch onto the eastern ledge.

fuchin-dark-right-door.objective: Take the right-hand doorway on the north wall
fuchin-dark-right-door.text: Walk left along the north edge of the eastern ledge to its doorway. Turn north through the doorway to continue.

fuchin-dark-path.objective: Follow the hidden crossing to the right-hand door
fuchin-dark-path.text: Walk to one square below the top of the western ledge. Follow the hidden path right until it stops, then north until it stops, then right onto the eastern ledge. Walk left along that ledge's north edge to the doorway. Go north through the doorway.

fuchin-blade-west-log.objective: Ride the southern vertical log west
fuchin-blade-west-log.text: Walk down the eastern side of the room to the vertical log. Board it from the eastern bank and ride west to the chest side.

fuchin-arctic-blade.objective: Open the chest on the western bank
fuchin-arctic-blade.text: Follow the western bank north to the chest and open it. Walk back south to the vertical log. Ride it east to resume the main route.

fuchin-blade-east-return.objective: Ride the vertical log back east
fuchin-blade-east-return.text: Return to the vertical log on the western bank and ride it back east.

fuchin-west-upper-log-south.text: Return to the horizontal log near the northern entrance and ride it south.

fuchin-west-upper-door.text: Step onto the southern bank and take the passage at its center.

fuchin-west-lower-log-east.objective: Follow the west wall and ride the log east
fuchin-west-lower-log-east.text: Follow the western wall south to the vertical log. Board it and ride east across the water.

fuchin-west-lower-exit.objective: Go north and east to the doorway
fuchin-west-lower-exit.text: Follow the bank north, then east to the doorway. Go through it to reach the western side of the entrance room. The vertical log there carries you back east across that room.

fuchin-zephyr-log-return.objective: Ride the northern horizontal log back south
fuchin-zephyr-log-return.text: Ride the northern horizontal log south to the lower part of the room, then return to the crossing near the Djinni.

fuchin-zephyr-first-south.objective: Ride the first horizontal log south
fuchin-zephyr-first-south.text: Follow the western wall down past the spikes to the first horizontal log. Board it and ride south.

fuchin-zephyr-vertical-west.text: Transfer to the vertical log beside the southern ledge and ride it left.

fuchin-zephyr-horizontal-north.objective: Ride the first horizontal log back north
fuchin-zephyr-horizontal-north.text: Step down onto the southern ledge. Board the first horizontal log again and ride it north. Leave the vertical log at its western dock for this move.

fuchin-zephyr-vertical-east.objective: Cross to the vertical log and ride east
fuchin-zephyr-vertical-east.text: Hop across the small stone between the logs. Board the vertical log and ride east to the opposite ledge.

fuchin-zephyr.objective: Approach the Djinni on the eastern ledge
fuchin-zephyr.text: Go east and then north along the ledge to the Djinni. Approach it and finish the battle.

fuchin-zephyr-last-log-north.objective: Ride the southern horizontal log north
fuchin-zephyr-last-log-north.text: Go south from the eastern ledge, staying clear of the spikes. Board the horizontal log and ride it all the way north. Step onto the northern bank and use its central doorway.

fuchin-zephyr-north-door.text: Step onto the northern bank and take the doorway at its center.

fuchin-eye-chamber-item.objective: Examine the pedestal in the back chamber
fuchin-eye-chamber-item.text: Examine the pedestal in this small chamber and finish receiving its item before going back upstairs.

fuchin-eye-chamber-return.objective: Leave the back chamber by its northern stairs
fuchin-eye-chamber-return.text: After collecting the item from the pedestal, walk to the north end of this small chamber. Climb the staircase there to return to the three-log room.

fuchin-eye-northern-door.objective: Cross the logs north to the statue-room route
fuchin-eye-northern-door.text: Hop north across the log crossing onto the northern bank. Take the stairs at the north end of the room. Follow the connecting passage to the dragon statue.

fuchin-eye-upper-horizontal.objective: Ride the upper horizontal log north
fuchin-eye-upper-horizontal.text: Board the upper of the two horizontal logs north of the entrance. Ride it north before moving the vertical log.

fuchin-eye-vertical-west.objective: Ride the upper vertical log west
fuchin-eye-vertical-west.text: Go around to the vertical log in the upper-right part of the pool. Board it and ride west. Move the lower horizontal log only after this crossing is in place.

fuchin-eye-lower-horizontal.objective: Ride the lower horizontal log north
fuchin-eye-lower-horizontal.text: Hop onto the northern bank and go back around to the entrance. Board the lower horizontal log. Ride north until it meets the vertical log, completing the crossing toward the western stairs.

fuchin-eye-western-stairs.objective: Hop west from the logs to the back-chamber stairs
fuchin-eye-western-stairs.text: From the log crossing, hop west onto the small stone. Continue west onto the bank and take its stairs down into the small back chamber.

fuchin-eye-layout-reset.objective: Reset the logs for the back chamber
fuchin-eye-layout-reset.text: Use Retreat, leave the grotto and re-enter to reset the logs to their starting arrangement. Follow the log-crossing directions again from the entrance.

fuchin-force-lower-hall.text: Follow the hall north and take the passage at its center into the small chamber.

fuchin-orb-of-force.objective: Open the chest beyond the water
fuchin-orb-of-force.text: Hop across the water to the chest beside the tablet. Open it and finish receiving its item before leaving the chamber.

fuchin-force-return-for-extras.text: Return south through the passage and take the eastern doorway back to the statue room.

fuchin-leave-grotto.objective: Use Retreat and return to the temple
fuchin-leave-grotto.text: Use Retreat to return to the grotto entrance. Leave through the waterfall and return to the temple. Speak with Master Nyunpa before continuing toward Mogall Forest.

mogall-leave.objective: Leave the forest by the south exit
mogall-leave.text: Finish the reward scene, leave Mogall Forest to the south and cross east toward Xian.

mogall-reward.text: Finish receiving the battle rewards before continuing. Make room in inventory if needed.

mogall-first-stump.objective: Use Force on the first stump
mogall-first-stump.text: Equip the Orb of Force and use Force on the first stump. Follow the creature into the forest.

mogall-first-log-route.objective: Follow the route to the log crossing
mogall-first-log-route.text: At the next stump, continue without using Force. Push the logs right, down, left, then up to make the crossing. Follow the creature onward.

mogall-west-clearing.objective: Clear the rock and log crossing
mogall-west-clearing.text: Move the obstructing rock into its hole, then shift the logs to open the crossing. Continue along the forest path.

mogall-creature-303.objective: Use Force on the stump, then follow the creature east
mogall-creature-303.text: Use Force on the indicated stump and follow the creature. Clear the rock and lower the logs to continue through the forest.

mogall-creature-304.objective: Follow the creature south to the next stump

mogall-creature-305.objective: Follow the creature west to the next stump

mogall-creature-306.objective: Use Force on the next stump

mogall-second-clearing-exit.text: Move the rock into the hole, lower the logs and continue along the forest path.

mogall-southern-logs.objective: Clear the rock and shift the log
mogall-southern-logs.text: Move the rock into its hole to clear the blocked log, then move the log east and cross.

mogall-creature-307.objective: Use Force on the middle stump
mogall-creature-307.text: Use Force on the creature's stump and follow its route. At the group of three stumps, choose the middle one.

mogall-creature-308.objective: Follow the creature to the next stump

mogall-creature-309.objective: Use Force and follow the creature onward

mogall-third-clearing-exit.text: Follow the forest path around the small stumps to the next crossing.

mogall-rock-crossing.text: Move the rock blocking the log into its hole. Move the log east, cross, then continue around the small stumps.

mogall-last-creature.text: Follow the creature south. Heal and save before continuing through the final clearing.

mogall-remaining-clearing.text: Follow the stump creature through the forest. Use Force at its stumps. Move obstructing rocks into holes and use the logs to cross.

xian-mist-route.objective: Stop the water carrier near the northeast corner; freeze her puddle
xian-mist-route.text: At the eastern cliff, stop the water carrier one tile below and one tile left of the northeast corner. Freeze the spilled water with Frost and cross to the cliff.

xian-training.objective: Stand beside the outlined stump and use Force
xian-training.text: Stand beside the outlined stump without touching its line and use Force. Go through the opened door and finish the conversation.

xian-leave.objective: Leave town and head north toward Alpine Crossing
xian-leave.text: Rest and shop if needed. Head north across the forest and bridges, then northwest to Alpine Crossing and north to Altin.

alpine-rescue.objective: Reveal the hidden door and Lift the trapped boulder
alpine-rescue.text: Use Reveal at the apparent dead end to uncover the door. Go through the door and use Lift on the boulder. Finish the rescue scene.

alpine-to-lama.text: Return to Lama Temple. Leave southwest toward Lamakan Desert.

alpine-to-desert.text: Return past Lama Temple and continue southwest toward Lamakan Desert.

alpine-to-altin.text: Follow Alpine Crossing north toward Altin.

lama-enter-temple.text: Go to the northwestern temple. Speak with Master Hama.

lama-conversation.text: Finish the temple conversation and training before leaving.

lama-revealed-chest.objective: Jump the eastern stream, Reveal the hidden chest and open it
lama-revealed-chest.text: Jump across the stream east of the temple. Use Reveal to find the hidden chest. Open the chest.

lama-hsu-return.text: Return east to Alpine Crossing. At the dead end, use Reveal to uncover the hidden door. Go through and use Lift on the boulder to complete the rescue.

lama-desert.text: Leave Lama Temple and travel southwest to Lamakan Desert. Use Reveal on the stone circles to find safe water.

kalay-sleep-bomb.text: Search the northwest corner of town.

kalay-town-vial.text: Search the southwest corner of town.

kalay-house-smoke-bomb.text: Search the northwest corner of this house.

kalay-house-coins.text: Search the southeast corner of this house.

kalay-inn-elixir.text: Search the northwest corner of this inn floor.

kalay-castle-water-jacket.objective: Open the chest in the southwest corner
kalay-castle-water-jacket.text: Open the chest in the southwest corner of this castle room.

kalay-castle-nut.text: Search the southeast corner of this castle room.

kalay-northeast-house.objective: Enter the house on the eastern side, north of the center
kalay-northeast-house.text: Enter the house on the eastern side, north of the center. Search its northwest corner.

kalay-southeast-house.text: Enter the southeastern house. Search its southeast corner.

kalay-inn-loot-return.text: Enter the inn. Climb upstairs. Search the northwest corner of that floor.

kalay-castle-loot-return.objective: Return to the castle side rooms
kalay-castle-loot-return.text: Go back up to the castle. Enter the western side room and open its chest. Search the southeast corner of the eastern side room.

kalay-castle-west-room.text: Take the western side doorway from the castle hall. Open the chest inside.

kalay-castle-east-room.text: Take the eastern side doorway from the castle hall. Search the southeast corner of that room.

kalay-inn-traveler.objective: Speak with the traveler beside the southeast exit
kalay-inn-traveler.text: Speak with the traveler beside the southeast exit of this inn floor. Finish the conversation, then leave the inn.

kalay-house-return.text: Leave this room and return outside to Kalay.

kalay-castle-left-return.text: Return through the eastern doorway to the castle hall.

kalay-castle-right-return.text: Return through the southern doorway to the castle hall.

kalay-after-rescue.objective: Finish the conversations and prepare to leave Kalay
kalay-after-rescue.text: Rest in Kalay if needed. Speak with Bunza in the castle hall about the secret entrance. Finish the castle exploration before returning through Gondowan Cave toward Tolbi.

kalay-lana.objective: Go to the castle and speak with Lady Lana
kalay-lana.text: Climb to Hammet's castle. Let Ivan speak with the guards. Go inside and finish the conversation with Lady Lana.

kalay-tour-group.objective: Speak with the tour group throughout the inn
kalay-tour-group.text: Visit every floor of the inn. Speak with the travelers on each floor. Leave the inn and let the departure scene finish.

kalay-tour-departure.objective: Leave the inn and finish the departure scene
kalay-tour-departure.text: Leave the inn. Finish the travelers' departure scene. Continue toward the docks.

kalay-vault-return.objective: Cross the repaired northern bridge and return to Vault
kalay-vault-return.text: Cross the repaired bridge north of Kalay and return to Vault. Ring the tower bell. Near the dog and graves, use Reveal to uncover the ladder.

kalay-vale-return.objective: Return west through Vault to Vale
kalay-vale-return.text: Return through Vault to Vale. At the western fence, use Lift to enter Vale Cave. Use Reveal to uncover the hidden stepping stone.

kalay-to-docks.text: Take the southern route around the caves to Kalay Docks. Buy a passage ticket at the north building. Board the ship.

kalay-docks-ticket.objective: Buy the passage ticket at the north counter for 600 coins
kalay-docks-ticket.text: Go to the north building. Speak with the ticket seller at the counter and buy the passage ticket for 600 coins.

kalay-docks-board.objective: Board the ship at the western docks
kalay-docks-board.text: Finish receiving the ticket. Board the ship at the western docks.

ship-landed.objective: Go ashore when the ship reaches land
ship-landed.text: Go ashore. If the ship has landed off course, explore the island or return aboard to continue toward Tolbi.

ship-volunteer-selected.objective: Return to the crew quarters with the replacement
ship-volunteer-selected.text: Go back down to the crew quarters with the passenger who agreed to row. Speak to the sailor to continue.

ship-find-volunteer.objective: Ask a passenger to replace the fallen rower
ship-find-volunteer.text: Speak to the passengers and ask one to row. Once someone agrees, return to the crew quarters.

ship-return-passengers.objective: Go to the passenger cabin for a replacement rower
ship-return-passengers.text: After the attack, go to the passenger cabin. Ask someone to replace the fallen rower.

ship-underway.objective: Respond to the calls from the deck
ship-underway.text: When the crew calls, go up to the deck. Fight the attacking monsters. Help replace the fallen rower before continuing.

ship-after-kraken.text: Finish the battle rewards and voyage scenes. Go ashore. If the ship landed off course, return aboard when ready to continue toward Tolbi.

ship-return-anchor.objective: Return the charm to the captain below deck
ship-return-anchor.text: Take the Anchor Charm back to the captain below deck and finish the conversation.

ship-find-anchor.objective: Search the observation deck for the charm
ship-find-anchor.text: Go to the observation deck. Search for the Anchor Charm. Return it to the captain below deck.

ship-start-voyage.objective: Go behind the tour guide and descend to the crew quarters
ship-start-voyage.text: Pass behind the tour guide. Descend the hidden stairs to the crew quarters to begin the voyage.

vault-cave-finished.objective: Use Retreat and leave the cave
vault-cave-finished.text: Use Retreat to return to the cave entrance, then leave Vault and continue toward Vale or Kalay Docks.

vault-cave-first-torch.objective: Move the torch onto the flame tile
vault-cave-first-torch.text: Follow the cave route to the first torch. Move it onto its flame tile to open the passage.

vault-cave-ice-and-switch.objective: Whirlwind the leaves; freeze every drop except the easternmost, cross and flip the switch
vault-cave-ice-and-switch.text: Use Whirlwind to clear the leaves. Use Frost on every water drop except the easternmost. Cross the ice pillars. Flip the water switch.

vault-cave-second-torch.objective: Move the lit torch onto the second flame tile
vault-cave-second-torch.text: Move the lit torch onto the second flame tile. Go through the opened gate.

vault-cave-lower-ladder.objective: Descend the drained ladder, then climb to the Djinni
vault-cave-lower-ladder.text: Go down the newly drained ladder. Follow the lower room route and climb out. Approach the Djinni and recruit it.

vault-cave-regular-exit.objective: Use Retreat and return to the main route
vault-cave-regular-exit.text: Cast Retreat to return to the Vault Cave entrance, then leave the cave. Leave Vault and take the southern route back to Kalay Docks when you are ready to resume the voyage.

vale-cave-leave.objective: Use Retreat and return to Kalay Docks
vale-cave-leave.text: Use Retreat to leave Vale Cave. Return to Kalay Docks by the southern route around the caves.

vale-cave-halt.objective: Equip the Halt Gem and stop the fleeing Djinni
vale-cave-halt.text: Chase the Djinni down the cliff. Equip the Halt Gem and cast Halt on it. Approach it and finish the encounter.

vale-cave-first-box.objective: Move the first box into the water
vale-cave-first-box.text: Use Move to slide the first box into the water and make a stepping stone.

vale-cave-second-box.objective: Move the other box into the water
vale-cave-second-box.text: Move the other box into the water, then cross and continue through the cave.

vale-cave-stones-east.text: Follow the stepping stones east to the doorway at the far end.

vale-cave-stones-west.text: Follow the stepping stones west to the doorway at the far end.

vale-cave-logs.objective: Arrange the logs and cross north
vale-cave-logs.text: Lower the side logs. Slide down the western notch. Push the cross-log north.

vale-cave-gem.objective: Climb north of the door and open the chest
vale-cave-gem.text: Follow the cave route to the ladder north of the door and open the chest.

vale-cave-reveal.text: Use Reveal to uncover the hidden stepping stone, then cross and follow the cave passage.

vale-cave-regular-exit.objective: Use Retreat and return to Kalay Docks
vale-cave-regular-exit.text: Cast Retreat to return to the Vale Cave entrance, then leave the cave. Return to Kalay Docks by the southern route around the caves when you are ready to resume the voyage.

lunpa-donpa-bedroom.objective: Speak with Donpa in his bedroom
lunpa-donpa-bedroom.text: Speak with Donpa in bed and finish his directions. The passage behind his wife leads to the Djinni.

lunpa-tonic-donpa.objective: Finish the rescue, then return to Donpa
lunpa-tonic-donpa.text: Let the rescue scenes finish and leave by the return route. Decline the wagon if you want to continue exploring. Re-enter the fortress and return to Donpa's bedroom.

lunpa-wife-doorway.objective: Enter the doorway behind Donpa's wife
lunpa-wife-doorway.text: Use the northern doorway behind Donpa's wife. Follow it into the small Djinni chamber.

lunpa-tonic-chamber.objective: Approach the Djinni in this chamber
lunpa-tonic-chamber.text: Walk north from the entrance and approach the Djinni. Finish the encounter before leaving through the southern doorway.

lunpa-tonic-room.objective: Enter the room behind Donpa's wife
lunpa-tonic-room.text: Return to Donpa's bedroom in the fortress. Use the opened doorway behind his wife to enter the Djinni chamber.

lunpa-kalay.objective: Return to Kalay and speak with Bunza
lunpa-kalay.text: Leave Lunpa and return to Kalay. Rest and speak with Bunza before taking the secret route beneath the castle.

lunpa-cloak-required.objective: Bring the Cloak Ball from Babi's room
lunpa-cloak-required.text: Return to Babi's room in Tolbi and inspect his desk. Bring the Cloak Ball and Catch Beads before entering the fortress.

lunpa-chest-hall-onward.objective: Take the southwestern door to the box passage
lunpa-chest-hall-onward.text: Take the southwestern doorway back into the fortress. Continue to the large box passage. The southeastern doorway returns to the earlier approach.

lunpa-northern-chest.objective: Check the northern chest in this hall
lunpa-northern-chest.text: Follow the central passage north to the chest and open it. Return south to the southwestern doorway when finished.

lunpa-prison.text: Heal and save before approaching the cell. Continue inside and finish the conversation and battle. Finish receiving the battle rewards before moving on.

lunpa-rescue-scene.text: Finish receiving the battle rewards, then continue the conversations.

lunpa-key-receiving.text: Finish the key-receiving conversation. Check the party's items for the key before leaving the chamber.

lunpa-cell-key.objective: Use Catch on the key through the bars
lunpa-cell-key.text: Equip the Catch Beads. Face the key through the bars and cast Catch. Finish receiving it before trying the locked exit.

lunpa-first-vines.objective: Clear the vines beside the locked passage
lunpa-first-vines.text: Use Whirlwind on the vines. Use Reveal to expose the hidden switch and examine it to open the door.

lunpa-first-switch.objective: Reveal and examine the hidden switch
lunpa-first-switch.text: Use Reveal and examine the switch behind the cleared vines. Take the northern passage when the door opens.

lunpa-northeast-vines.text: Cross the small river gap and go northeast. Clear the doorway's vines with Whirlwind, then use Reveal to expose the entrance.

lunpa-northeast-room-onward.objective: Pass through the northeastern room to reach the box
lunpa-northeast-room-onward.text: Enter the cleared northeastern doorway. Follow the hall and take its southwestern doorway back into the fortress. You can reach the north side of the large box from there.

lunpa-box.objective: Push the large box south off the ledge
lunpa-box.text: Push the large box south until it drops off the ledge. Jump west and continue through the cell passage.

lunpa-last-vines.objective: Clear the vines on the western route
lunpa-last-vines.text: Clear the remaining western vines with Whirlwind. Use Reveal to expose the passage, then enter it.

lunpa-to-prison.objective: Take the western passage toward the cell
lunpa-to-prison.text: Take the revealed western passage. Heal and save before continuing into the cell beyond.

lunpa-hidden-door.objective: Clear the vines and Reveal the hidden door
lunpa-hidden-door.text: Use Whirlwind to clear the vines. Cast Reveal and examine the hidden switch or doorway. Continue through the opened passage. In the box passage, push the large box south until it drops, then jump west to continue.

lunpa-key-chamber-onward.objective: Leave by the eastern stairs after taking the key
lunpa-key-chamber-onward.text: Use the cell key on the locked exit. Continue past the guard and take the eastern stairs onward.

lunpa-key-stair-connector.objective: Take the other northern stairs toward the locked passage
lunpa-key-stair-connector.text: From the key-room stairs, go west to the other northern staircase. Avoid the doorway leading back toward the fortress entrance.

lunpa-fortress-route.objective: Use Cloak in the shadows and continue past the guards
lunpa-fortress-route.text: Equip the Cloak Ball and cast Cloak in shadow. Recast it after entering new rooms or crossing light. Follow the shaded route past the guards and use the key on locked doors. If spotted, return to the entrance and try the same shaded route again.

lunpa-enter-fortress.text: Enter Lunpa through the cave. Use Cloak in the shadows to pass the fortress guards.

lunpa-tonic-chamber-return.text: Take the southern doorway back to Donpa's bedroom. Retrace the fortress route when ready to leave.

lunpa-regular-exit.objective: Return to the main route toward Suhalla
lunpa-regular-exit.text: Leave Lunpa and return through Kalay. Continue through Gondowan Cave toward Tolbi to rejoin the main route. Check the current main journey before choosing your next destination.

gondowan-side-chest-fa0.objective: Check the northern chest in the upper passage
gondowan-side-chest-fa0.text: Check the northern chest along this upper passage. Return to the cave route afterward.

gondowan-side-chest-fa1.objective: Check the southern chest in the upper passage
gondowan-side-chest-fa1.text: Check the southern chest along this upper passage. Return to the cave route afterward.

gondowan-return.objective: Lift the rock and follow the cave route toward Kalay
gondowan-return.text: Equip the Lifting Gem and Lift the blocking rock. Follow the cave route and check its side chests. Move the log and tree to open the crossing. Continue past Kalay and Vault toward Lunpa.

gondowan-to-tolbi.objective: Follow the cave route back toward Tolbi
gondowan-to-tolbi.text: Follow the cave route toward Tolbi, then cross the southern bridge and head southeast toward Suhalla.

kalay-secret-chest-connector.objective: Take the western stairs to the chest cavern
kalay-secret-chest-connector.text: Follow the connecting passage to its western stairs. Descend into the cavern with the waterfall and four chests.

kalay-secret-chest-freeze.objective: Freeze the drop below the stopped waterfall
kalay-secret-chest-freeze.text: Climb down the eastern ladder and use Frost on the remaining drop. Climb back up to cross the ice pillar.

kalay-secret-chest-cross.objective: Cross the ice pillar to the western chest
kalay-secret-chest-cross.text: Climb back to the upper ledge and hop across the ice pillar. Open the chest, then retrace the crossing to the ladder.

kalay-secret-four-chests.objective: Check the four chests at the south end
kalay-secret-four-chests.text: Follow the western cavern south to the four chests. Open any remaining chest before arranging the waterfall statue.

kalay-secret-west-room-chest.objective: Check the chest in the eastern side of this room
kalay-secret-west-room-chest.text: Follow the room to its eastern chest and open it. Return to the southern doorway when finished.

kalay-spirit-gloves.objective: Block the waterfall and freeze the drop
kalay-spirit-gloves.text: Push the statue north, then west until it blocks the waterfall. Climb down the eastern ladder and freeze the remaining drop. Climb back up and cross the ice pillar to the chest.

kalay-secret-djinni-connector.objective: Take the eastern stairs to the Djinni cavern
kalay-secret-djinni-connector.text: Follow the passage south and east, then go north along the eastern wall. Take the stairs into the second waterfall cavern.

kalay-secret-djinni-drained.objective: Cross the drained cavern to the Djinni
kalay-secret-djinni-drained.text: Climb down into the drained cavern. Cross to the other ladder and climb up to approach the Djinni.

kalay-scorch.objective: Block the next waterfall and climb down to the Djinni
kalay-scorch.text: Follow the eastern cavern south to its waterfall. Push the statue west into the falling water. Once the cavern drains, climb down and cross to the other ladder. Climb to the Djinni.

kalay-secret-return-west-cavern.objective: Return north up the western cavern stairs
kalay-secret-return-west-cavern.text: Retrace the upper ledge to the northern stairs. Climb back to the connecting passage.

kalay-secret-return-east-cavern.objective: Return north from the Djinni cavern
kalay-secret-return-east-cavern.text: Retrace the crossing and climb to the upper ledge. Follow the cavern north to the stairs back to the connecting passage.

kalay-secret-return-lower-connector.objective: Take the northwestern stairs back toward the castle
kalay-secret-return-lower-connector.text: Follow the passage to the northwestern stairs. They lead into the upper connecting chamber.

kalay-secret-return-upper-connector.objective: Take the northern stairs to the western room
kalay-secret-return-upper-connector.text: Follow this upper chamber to its northern stairs. Continue through the western room and its southern doorway toward the exit.

kalay-secret-return-west-room.text: Take the southern doorway back toward the tunnel entrance. Leave for the world map when ready to return toward Tolbi.

kalay-return-tolbi.objective: Return through Gondowan Cave toward Tolbi
kalay-return-tolbi.text: Finish the Kalay conversations and leave the tunnels. Backtrack through Gondowan Cave toward Tolbi. Rest there before following the southern bridge route to Suhalla.

suhalla-iodem-inside.objective: Speak with Iodem in this house
suhalla-iodem-inside.text: Speak with Iodem and finish the conversation about sandstorms. Check that Douse is available before leaving for the desert.

suhalla-iodem-wrong-building.objective: Return outside to the southwestern red-roofed house
suhalla-iodem-wrong-building.text: Leave this building and return to Suhalla. Visit the red-roofed house in the southwest and speak with Iodem.

suhalla-iodem.objective: Visit Iodem in the red-roofed house
