suhalla-iodem.text: Go to the red-roofed house in southwestern Suhalla. Speak with Iodem about sandstorms. Restock and check Douse before entering the desert.

suhalla-leave-building.objective: Return outside before entering the desert
suhalla-leave-building.text: Leave this building and return to Suhalla. Equip the Douse Drop if Douse is missing, then enter the desert.

suhalla-enter-desert.objective: Equip Douse and enter the desert
suhalla-enter-desert.text: Check that Douse is available in the Psynergy menu. Equip the Douse Drop if needed. Enter Suhalla Desert and keep Douse ready for the storms.

suhalla-flash.objective: Reveal the stump on the western ledge to reach the Djinni
suhalla-flash.text: Take the middle storm path in the second desert area and continue north. Near the colored storm, use Reveal on the western ledge to expose a stump. Cross it and climb down to the Djinni. After the battle, climb back up and retrace the stump crossing east.

suhalla-side-cave-return-west.objective: Take the cave stairs back toward the desert ridge
suhalla-side-cave-return-west.text: Follow the passage northeast to its stairs. On the other side, follow the passage south and leave the cave.

suhalla-side-cave-return-east.objective: Leave the cave through its southern opening
suhalla-side-cave-return-east.text: Follow the passage south to the cave mouth. It returns to the desert near the colored storm. Rejoin the main ridge and ladder for the route onward.

suhalla-exit.objective: Return from the desert side cave
suhalla-exit.text: Return through the cave passages to the desert. This side cave connects two desert ledges. The main route to Suhalla Gate continues outside.

suhalla-storm-cleared.text: Follow the remaining desert path south. Use the stone in the rock circle if needed. Continue along the path to its eastern exit, then travel east toward Suhalla Gate.

suhalla-first-path.objective: Douse the storms and take the eastern, then middle path
suhalla-first-path.text: Go west from the entrance, then follow the passage south. When the first storm catches you, use Douse and finish the battle. At the first three-way fork, take the easternmost storm path. Follow it west into the next area.

suhalla-middle-fork.text: At this area's three-way fork, take the middle storm path. Use Douse when caught and finish the battle. Follow the passage north afterward.

suhalla-flash-return.objective: Return up the ladder from the Djinni ledge
suhalla-flash-return.text: Climb back up from the Djinni ledge. Use Reveal again if needed and retrace the hidden-stump crossing east. Continue toward the main ladder.

suhalla-giant-storm.objective: Heal, save and Douse the giant southern storm
suhalla-giant-storm.text: Follow the northern passage to the main ridge. Leave the colored storm for its optional island route. Heal and save before descending the main ladder. Go south and use Douse when the giant storm catches you. Finish the battle and rewards before continuing.

suhalla-gate-mint.objective: Slide to the chest below this first cliff
suhalla-gate-mint.text: Take the first slide on this cliff to the chest below. Open it and finish receiving the item. Climb the vines back to the upper path, then continue east to the next cliff.

suhalla-gate-dew.objective: Take the third slide from the left
suhalla-gate-dew.text: At the row of slides, use the third one from the left. Approach the Djinni on the ledge and finish the battle. Slide down again, go east and climb the vines back to the upper path.

suhalla-gate-east-exit.objective: Descend the eastern stairs to the world map
suhalla-gate-east-exit.text: Follow the upper path east past the guard. Descend the stairs and leave from the eastern end. On the world map, continue northeast to Venus Lighthouse.

suhalla-gate-north.objective: Heal with the minister, then continue through the gate
suhalla-gate-north.text: Climb the stairs and finish the conversation by the gate. Continue north. Enter the small doorway if the party needs healing. Return outside and take the eastern path toward the cliffs.

suhalla-gate-first-cliff-onward.objective: Continue east along the upper cliff
suhalla-gate-first-cliff-onward.text: If you slid down for the chest, climb the vines back up. Follow the upper path east to the next cliff and its row of slides.

suhalla-ship-cave-return.objective: Return to the cliff path outside
suhalla-ship-cave-return.text: This cave is a side route from the cliff. Retrace the passage to its entrance and go outside. Climb the remaining vines and follow the upper cliff east to the gate stairs.

suhalla-gate-lighthouse.text: From the lower ledge, go east and climb all the vines back to the upper path. Continue east past the cave entrance and leave toward the gate stairs. The eastern stairs lead back to the world map.

crossbone-demon-mail.objective: Open the chest at the north end of the ship
crossbone-demon-mail.text: After the battle and reward conversation, continue to the north end of the ship and open the chest there.

crossbone-ship-return.objective: Return from the ship when finished
crossbone-ship-return.text: Finish the battle and any receiving conversation before leaving. Use Retreat and leave the cave. On the island world map, go to the northwest beach and enter the pink tornado without using Douse. If it is absent, enter the island cave area and come back outside to restore it.

crossbone-finished.objective: Return to Venus Lighthouse when ready
crossbone-finished.text: Finish receiving the chest item. Use Retreat to return toward the dungeon entrance, then go outside. Return to the world map and use the island's pink tornado for the trip back. Continue through Babi's Lighthouse and the ruins to return to Venus Lighthouse.

crossbone-deadbeard.objective: Heal and save before approaching the ship
crossbone-deadbeard.text: Descend to the ship. Heal and save before exploring the dock.

crossbone-floor-1-chest-1.objective: Floor 1: reach the chest on the southwest ledge
crossbone-floor-1-chest-1.text: Start with the stumps in their original positions. Hop onto the small stone below the nearest stump and use Move to shift the stump right. Jump west along the stepping stones to the chest on the southwest ledge.

crossbone-floor-1-chest-2.objective: Floor 1: reach the chest on the southeast ledge
crossbone-floor-1-chest-2.text: Leave this puzzle room and re-enter to restore the starting arrangement. From the small ledge below the entry stump, Move it left. Hop onto the stump platform, then cross east to the chest on the southeast ledge.

crossbone-floor-1-chest-3.objective: Floor 1: open the chest reached by the western stepping stones
crossbone-floor-1-chest-3.text: Leave this puzzle room and re-enter if needed to restore the stumps. Move the entry stump right. Follow the western stepping stones north to the next stump. Stand below it and use Move to shift it right. Continue along the western stepping stones to the northwest chest.

crossbone-floor-1-chest-4.objective: Floor 1: circle the outer ledge to the northern chest
crossbone-floor-1-chest-4.text: From the northwest chest route, step back onto the outer ledge. Follow that ledge counterclockwise until you reach the chest near the north-middle of the room. You can reach this chest without resetting again.

crossbone-floor-1-exit.objective: Floor 1: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-1-exit.text: Start from the original stump arrangement. Step out and re-enter if needed. From the small stone below the nearest stump, Move the stump right. Go northwest to the next stump and Move it left. Cross east to the northeast corner, then west to the stump on the ledge. Shift it one space east. Go back to the middle stump, Move it right and hop onto it. Shift the earlier northwest stump east, cross onto the outer ledge and follow it south to the exit.

crossbone-floor-2-chest-1.objective: Floor 2: walk north from the entrance to the first chest
crossbone-floor-2-chest-1.text: Enter the room and follow the path directly north. Open the chest just beyond the entrance before moving any logs.

crossbone-floor-2-chest-2.objective: Floor 2: go around the blocks to the eastern chest
crossbone-floor-2-chest-2.text: From the chest north of the entrance, circle the nearby blocks counterclockwise. Follow the open path northeast to the next chest. Leave the logs where they are for now.

crossbone-floor-2-chest-3.objective: Floor 2: follow the eastern edge to the northeast chest
crossbone-floor-2-chest-3.text: From the chest beside the blocks, continue around to the easternmost path. Turn north and follow it to the chest in the northeast corner. This route does not require moving a log.

crossbone-floor-2-chest-4.objective: Floor 2: arrange the logs for the northwest chest
crossbone-floor-2-chest-4.text: Push the horizontal log north of the entrance-side chest upward. Go around to the northeast chest and push the vertical log there left. Circle south around the broken pillar, then push both horizontal logs beside the eastern chest north, upper one first. Return northwest of the entrance-side chest, push the vertical log right and the horizontal log north, then cross to the northwest chest.

crossbone-floor-2-exit.objective: Floor 2: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-2-exit.text: Use the log arrangement for the northwest chest: the western vertical log must be shifted right and its horizontal log north. From the northwest chest ledge, follow the western edge south to the exit door.

crossbone-floor-3-chest-1.objective: Floor 3: catch the leftmost blue gem and use its door
crossbone-floor-3-chest-1.text: Equip the Catch Beads. From the northeastern tip of the entrance platform, face the nearest blue gem and cast Catch. Return across the platform, then take the stepping stones on the northwest side to the upper ledge. Use the gem on the leftmost blue door and open the chest beyond it.

crossbone-floor-3-chest-2.objective: Floor 3: catch the second blue gem from the eastern side
crossbone-floor-3-chest-2.text: Return to the entrance platform. From its northwest corner, follow the stepping stones southeast. At the eastern wall, take the path that bends back toward the gem until you stand directly east of it. Face west and use Catch. Return to the upper ledge by the western stepping stones and open the second blue door from the left.

crossbone-floor-3-chest-3.objective: Floor 3: reach the third blue gem from the western stepping stones
crossbone-floor-3-chest-3.text: Take the western stepping-stone route toward the blue doors. At its branch, hop one space east, then continue north to the two long platforms with a small landing between them. Face south toward the gem and cast Catch. Return to the blue-door ledge and open the second door from the right.

crossbone-floor-3-chest-4.objective: Floor 3: catch the rightmost blue gem from below
crossbone-floor-3-chest-4.text: From the entrance platform, follow the stepping stones northeast, then north when the route straightens. Stop directly below the remaining blue gem, face north and cast Catch. Return along the western route to the upper ledge and use the gem at the rightmost blue door.

crossbone-floor-3-exit.objective: Floor 3: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-3-exit.text: Leave the rightmost chest doorway and go south to the northern point of the circular stepping-stone formation. Use Reveal, face the hidden red gem and cast Catch. Return west along the upper ledge, then descend the western stepping stones. Near the southern end, jump west to the red-door ledge. Use the red gem, pass through the door and continue south to the floor exit.

crossbone-floor-4-cloak-needed.objective: Bring the Cloak Ball for this route
crossbone-floor-4-cloak-needed.text: Bring the Cloak Ball and equip it on a party member before attempting this floor's statue route. Cast Cloak while standing in shadow and stay in shadow while passing the statues. If you do not have the ball, return to the main journey and come back with it.

crossbone-floor-4-chest-1.objective: Floor 4: pass the second statue to the northern chest
crossbone-floor-4-chest-1.text: Go east from the entrance to the second moving statue. Trap it against the wall and cast Halt, then slip past. In the shadows, use Cloak to pass the next statue. Use Reveal to see the path. Follow the north wall west to the chest, then return to the entrance-side passage.

crossbone-floor-4-chest-2.objective: Floor 4: pass the first statue to the chest at the end of its hall
crossbone-floor-4-chest-2.text: Return to the first moving statue east of the entrance. Lure it right and cast Halt to leave a gap you can pass through. Follow its hallway north and use Reveal to find the chest at the far end. Return south afterward.

crossbone-floor-4-chest-3.objective: Floor 4: follow the shadow route to the northeast chest
crossbone-floor-4-chest-3.text: Halt the second statue east of the entrance, then go north and use Cloak in the shadows. Beyond the statue in the dark, turn right. Stay in shadow as you pass the statue in the lit area, then circle clockwise around it to the northeast chest. Backtrack to the entrance passage afterward.

crossbone-floor-4-chest-4.objective: Floor 4: take the western shadow passage to the chest by the exit
crossbone-floor-4-chest-4.text: Go west from the room entrance and follow the narrow passage north. Cast Cloak when you reach the shadows and stay inside them while passing the statue. Open the chest along this exit passage before leaving the floor.

crossbone-floor-4-exit.objective: Floor 4: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-4-exit.text: From the entrance passage, go west and follow the narrow hall north. Use Cloak in the shadows and remain in shadow while passing the statue. Follow the passage past the chest to the exit.

crossbone-floor-5-chest-1.objective: Floor 5: follow the upper ledge to the chest by the northeast stairs
crossbone-floor-5-chest-1.text: From the entrance, follow the upper ledge counterclockwise around the pool. Open the chest beside the stairs in the northeast corner before descending.

crossbone-floor-5-chest-2.objective: Floor 5: make the floating-log crossing to the northern chest
crossbone-floor-5-chest-2.text: Start with the pool drained and the logs in their original arrangement. Descend the northeast stairs. Push the first vertical log left, then push the horizontal log southeast of it north. Move the vertical log back right. Climb out, use the switch to fill the pool and hop across the floating logs to the north-middle chest.

crossbone-floor-5-chest-3.objective: Floor 5: rearrange the drained pool for the southwest chest
crossbone-floor-5-chest-3.text: Leave and re-enter the room to reset, then descend into the drained pool. Go west to the two vertical logs with a horizontal log between them. Move the lower vertical log east, the horizontal log south, then the vertical log back west. Push the horizontal log beside the upper vertical log south. Move the lower western vertical log east again, then restore the last horizontal log north. Climb out, fill the pool and cross to the southwest chest.

crossbone-floor-5-chest-4.objective: Floor 5: use the exit arrangement to reach the northwest chest
crossbone-floor-5-chest-4.text: Reset the room if its logs are arranged for another chest. In the drained pool, push the second horizontal log from the east south. Move the northeast vertical log east, then the horizontal log just southwest of it north. Move the northern vertical log west and restore the first horizontal log north. Move the vertical log against the west wall east, then the horizontal log above it south. Fill the pool and cross to the western ledge. The chest is just west of your landing.

crossbone-floor-5-exit.objective: Floor 5: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-5-exit.text: From the northwest chest, return to the ledge where you stepped off the floating logs. Follow this western ledge all the way south to the exit door. If the logs were reset, first make the crossing described for the northwest chest.

crossbone-floor-6-chest-1.objective: Floor 6: set the entrance stumps for the first northern chest
crossbone-floor-6-chest-1.text: At the entrance, Move the left stump to its leftmost position. Leave the other stump one space short of the right edge. Hop across this pair toward the north and open the chest above the entrance route.

crossbone-floor-6-chest-2.objective: Floor 6: follow the northern ledge and freeze the pool for its chest
crossbone-floor-6-chest-2.text: From the first chest, go north, down the ladder and up the ladder to the west. Follow the northern ledge west to the movable stump beside a slide. Push it down the slide and slide after it. Descend the next ladder and Frost the puddle just east of it. Climb back up and hop north across the pillars to the chest on the northern ledge.

crossbone-bane-halt-needed.objective: Bring the Halt Gem for this route
crossbone-bane-halt-needed.text: Catching this Djinni needs Halt. Bring the Halt Gem from Vale Cave and equip it on a party member, then return to this route. The ice pillar and stump crossing lead back to the Djinni when you are ready.

crossbone-bane.objective: Follow the Djinni to the northeast, then use Halt
crossbone-bane.text: From the northern chest ledge, continue north toward the Djinni. Push the nearby stump right, climb the ladder and follow the upper ledge east. When the Djinni moves to the northeast corner, go down the large ladder and up the small one. Follow the ledge south, cross the two stumps by the entrance and climb the ladder. Stand directly south of the Djinni with the block between you. Cast Halt on the Djinni, then walk around and approach it.

crossbone-floor-6-chest-3.objective: Floor 6: move the chest-bearing stump to reach the middle ledge
crossbone-floor-6-chest-3.text: After the Djinni route, stay on this floor. At ground level, push the stump carrying a chest north along the middle of the room. Climb the eastern ladder, cross the two entry stumps and go north. Descend the small ladder, climb the large one west of it, then continue west to the next small ladder. Descend, push the stump east, descend again and Move the log east as far as it goes. Retrace the two small ladders and descend the large ladder. Hop from the stump to the middle ledge and open the chest.

crossbone-floor-6-chest-4.objective: Floor 6: set the southern stump for the chest above the lower platform
crossbone-floor-6-chest-4.text: From the middle chest, cross back to the stump and climb the large ladder. Descend one small ladder and follow the ledge south to the ice pillar. Cross to the stump and descend. Move this stump east. Before placing it in its final northern position, get to its north side and use Move so you can still get out. Return north and climb the small ladder. Follow the upper ledge south and jump from the ice pillar to the stump, then to the chest platform.

crossbone-floor-6-exit.objective: Floor 6: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-6-exit.text: From the southern chest, hop back over the pillars and go north. Descend the small ladder and follow the lower route south to the stump you moved for that chest. Use Move to shift it south and then west, opening the passage to the southern exit.

crossbone-floor-7-carry-needed.objective: Bring the Carry Stone for this route
crossbone-floor-7-carry-needed.text: Bring the Carry Stone and equip it on a party member before attempting this floor's small-block puzzles. If it is not in your items, return to the main journey and come back with it.

crossbone-floor-7-chest-1.objective: Floor 7: carry the first block north to the northeast chest
crossbone-floor-7-chest-1.text: Follow the entrance hall northeast. Jump west across the gap and continue west to the small block. Push it as far right as it goes, then north to the ledge. Use Carry to raise it one space north onto that ledge. Climb the ladder and follow the ledge east to the chest.

crossbone-floor-7-chest-2.objective: Floor 7: carry the block west and north to the raised chest
crossbone-floor-7-chest-2.text: Leave and re-enter this room to reset the block. Go back to the first small block. Keep it on its starting row and push it fully left, then Carry it onto the western ledge. Jump the gap, climb the ladder and descend the ladder to the east. Move the block one space north and Carry it onto the ledge above. Climb back up and jump across the raised block to the chest.

crossbone-floor-7-chest-3.objective: Floor 7: drop the western block for the middle chest crossing
crossbone-floor-7-chest-3.text: Begin from a reset room. Push the first block west and Carry it onto the western ledge. Jump the gap, climb the large ladder and descend the small one. Push the block left off the platform, then place it two spaces left of the ledge's lowest square. Climb back up and descend again to the jumping level. Use the block to reach the platform against the west wall, then follow it southeast to the chest.

crossbone-floor-7-chest-4.objective: Floor 7: jump onto the ledge below the chest beside the exit
crossbone-floor-7-chest-4.text: At the chest just east of the exit door, face the ledge directly below it and jump across. The wall hides the landing square, but it is part of the chest platform. Open the chest, then hop back to the passage.

crossbone-floor-7-exit.objective: Floor 7: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-7-exit.text: Return across the gap from the western chest route, climb up and descend the large ladder. Cross the gap and follow the narrow passage south. At its end, hop west to the other small block. Move it fully south, then fully left. Carry it onto the ledge to its north, climb the ladder and jump across. Descend the western ladder and follow the passage south to the exit.

crossbone-floor-8-chest-1.objective: Floor 8: freeze the pool below the white platform for the eastern chest
crossbone-floor-8-chest-1.text: Follow the entrance hall north to the white platform with a puddle beneath it. Use Frost on that puddle, then climb the ladder to the north. Follow the upper cliff south and open the chest on the eastern side.

crossbone-floor-8-chest-2.objective: Floor 8: freeze the second puddle and cross to the upper middle chest
crossbone-floor-8-chest-2.text: Go back down the ladder from the eastern chest and Frost the puddle blocking the crossing. Return north, climb the ladder again and jump across the gap to the upper chest in the middle of the room.

crossbone-floor-8-chest-3.objective: Floor 8: use the dragon and logs to reach the lower middle chest
crossbone-floor-8-chest-3.text: Start from a reset room: leave and re-enter if you froze the puddle beneath the white platform. Frost the puddle south of the east-cliff ladder, leaving the platform puddle unfrozen. Reach the upper-middle chest ledge and slide down. Circle the logs and push the small dark rock east. Climb the ladder northwest of it and cross back toward the dragon. Slide down, push the horizontal log south, then freeze the platform puddle. After the dragon melts the obstructing ice, cross the puddle and refreeze it from the north side. Climb and cross the gap, slide down the next ledge, push its horizontal log south and climb to the lower-middle chest.

crossbone-floor-8-chest-4.objective: Floor 8: cross the ice pillar to the northwest chest
crossbone-floor-8-chest-4.text: From the lower-middle chest, descend the ladder and go northwest. Hop over the puddle before casting Frost on it from the far side. Climb the ladder and jump across the ice pillar to the chest on the northwest cliff.

crossbone-floor-8-exit.objective: Floor 8: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-8-exit.text: From the northwest chest ledge, slide down the crevice. Follow the lower passage south and leave through the doorway at its end.

crossbone-floor-9-chest-1.objective: Floor 9: ride the logs to the island in the eastern lake
crossbone-floor-9-chest-1.text: Walk north to the lakes. Ride the western horizontal log north, then the vertical log above it east. Step onto the east bank and walk south to the next horizontal log. Ride it north. Hop east to the pair of vertical logs, go south and ride the southeast vertical log west to the central island chest.

crossbone-floor-9-chest-2.objective: Floor 9: ride the northern log west to the chest above the lake
crossbone-floor-9-chest-2.text: Leave and re-enter to reset the logs. Follow the eastern bank north and ride the northernmost vertical log west. Hop onto the ledge to the north and open the chest.

crossbone-floor-9-chest-3.objective: Floor 9: use the lower vertical log to reach the chest between the lakes
crossbone-floor-9-chest-3.text: Start from a reset room. Ride the western horizontal log north and the vertical log above it east. On the eastern bank, go south and ride the horizontal log north. Hop east onto the vertical log and ride it west. Transfer south to the vertical log below it and ride that one all the way west to the platform between the lakes. Open the chest there.

crossbone-floor-9-chest-4.objective: Floor 9: arrange the western lake logs for the northwest chest
crossbone-floor-9-chest-4.text: From the chest between the lakes, go southwest and ride the horizontal logs north. Ride the lowest vertical log west, then move the horizontal log above it south. Return to ride the middle vertical log west, then the horizontal log above that south. Go back around to the northernmost vertical log and ride it west. Hop north to the chest on the northwest ledge.

crossbone-floor-9-exit.objective: Floor 9: reach the exit to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-floor-9-exit.text: Ride the final vertical log back east from the northwest chest. Step onto the ledge and follow it south to the exit door.

crossbone-island-chests.objective: Check the middle and right slides
crossbone-island-chests.text: On the western cliff, use Growth on the plants and climb their vines until you reach the top. Take the middle slide to its chest. Climb back up and take the right slide for the other chest. The left slide leads to the cave route.

crossbone-island-entrance.objective: Whirlwind the shrub on the left slide route
crossbone-island-entrance.text: Use Growth on the plants along the western cliff and climb their vines to the top. Take the leftmost slide. Face the shrub below and use Whirlwind to uncover the cave entrance. Go inside, follow the hall north and descend the large staircase.

crossbone-stairs.text: Descend the large staircase and enter the next floor doorway. Finish any battle blocking that doorway before entering. Whenever a floor exit rejoins the stairs, push the nearby stump down to open its shortcut before continuing farther down.

crossbone-shared-corridor.objective: Follow the passage back to the dungeon stairs
crossbone-shared-corridor.text: Follow this side passage back to the dungeon stairs. Move the blocking stump down where the passage meets the stairs, opening the shortcut for return trips. Descend to the next floor doorway, or climb the stairs to leave.

crossbone-regular-exit.objective: Leave the island and return to the main route
crossbone-regular-exit.text: Return to the island exit or ship to leave Crossbone Island. Once back on the world map, follow your current main journey. You do not need to finish every island treasure before leaving.

altin-cookie-chamber.objective: Lift the boulder and open the northern chest
altin-cookie-chamber.text: Equip the Lifting Gem on a party member. Face the boulder blocking the northern chest and use Lift. Pass the raised boulder and open the chest. Return through the southern doorway when finished.

altin-cookie-blocked.text: Leave this small chamber through its southern doorway and continue the mine route. Return for the northern chest after obtaining the Lifting Gem. Equip it and use Lift on the boulder before approaching the chest.

altin-cookie-return.text: Leave this small chamber through the southern doorway. Continue the mine route outside. The northern chest is a side trip.

altin-psy-crystal.objective: Open the chest north of the entrance
altin-psy-crystal.text: Walk north through this small cave to the chest. Open it, then retrace the cave south to return to Altin.

altin-psy-crystal-return.text: Leave through the southern doorway to return to town.

altin-vial-chamber.text: Walk north to the chest in this small cave and open it. Return south through the same doorway to the main exit passage.

altin-vial-return.text: Return south to the main exit passage.

altin-town-crystal.objective: Move the western statue and enter its cave
altin-town-crystal.text: Go to the statue west of town and use Move to uncover the cave entrance. Enter the small cave and walk north to its chest. Return through the southern doorway afterward.

altin-town-cookie-return.objective: Return to the earlier Lift-blocked chest
altin-town-cookie-return.text: Return along the earlier statue route to the small chest chamber. Lift its boulder and open the chest.

altin-leave.objective: Take the lowest mine entrance toward Lama Temple
altin-leave.text: Enter the lowest mine entrance and take the forward fork. Equip the Lifting Gem and use Lift on the exit boulder. Pass underneath it and follow the passage toward Lama Temple.

altin-first-monster.objective: Follow the creature into the cave
altin-first-monster.text: Descend the ladder outside the inn and follow the creature into the cave.

altin-lower-mine.text: Descend the two ladders in eastern Altin and enter the mine.

altin-first-statue.objective: Follow the creature and slide down to challenge it
altin-first-statue.text: Follow the creature through the cave to the cliff. Slide down to its lower level. Approach the statue and finish the battle.

altin-first-statue-exit.objective: Freeze the puddle and cross back outside
altin-first-statue-exit.text: Finish the reward conversation before moving on. Use Frost on the puddle below to make an ice pillar. Cross the pillar to reach the way out.

altin-second-switch.objective: Flip the switch east of the cart
altin-second-switch.text: Follow the southern shore around to the western side of the chamber and find the cart. Flip the switch just east of the cart. Return to the cart to cross the water.

altin-second-statue-landed.objective: Approach the statue from the far-shore stop
altin-second-statue-landed.text: Step off the cart at the far-shore stop. Approach the statue and finish the battle. Finish the reward scene before returning to the cart.

altin-second-statue.objective: Ride the cart and challenge the statue
altin-second-statue.text: Board the cart beside the switch and ride to the far shore. Step off at its stop. Approach the statue and finish the battle.

altin-second-statue-cart-back.objective: Ride back to the earlier track junction
altin-second-statue-cart-back.text: Return to the cart at the far-shore stop and ride back to its starting ledge. Leave this chamber and retrace the passage to the earlier track junction. Take the staircase in that junction's northwest corner.

altin-second-statue-exit.objective: Ride back and return to the junction
altin-second-statue-exit.text: Return to the earlier track junction. If the cart is still on the statue's far shore, ride it back to the starting ledge first. Retrace the connecting passage to the junction and take the staircase in its northwest corner.

altin-entry-junction.objective: Follow the eastern track to the northeastern stairs
altin-entry-junction.text: In this track junction, follow the rails along the eastern side of the chamber. Take the staircase in the northeast corner to continue toward the next flooded chamber.

altin-return-junction.objective: Take the northwestern stairs from the track junction
altin-return-junction.text: From this track junction, go to the staircase in the northwest corner. Take it into the connecting passage, then descend through that passage to continue deeper into the mine.

altin-upper-connector.objective: Follow the passage to the next cart lake
altin-upper-connector.text: Descend through the passage to the next cart lake.

altin-middle-switch.objective: Set the rail switch toward the west
altin-middle-switch.text: Follow the western track south to its switch. Set the switch toward the west. Walk back north to the cart and board it.

altin-middle-cart-landed.objective: Leave the cart at the northern stop
altin-middle-cart-landed.text: Step off the cart at the northern stop and take the nearby doorway. Follow the connecting western passage south to continue through the mine.

altin-middle-cart.objective: Ride the cart across the lake
altin-middle-cart.text: Board the cart and ride across the lake to the doorway. Step off and enter the passage. Follow that western passage south to continue.

altin-mimic-chamber.objective: Open the chest on the western side
altin-mimic-chamber.text: Open the western chest before continuing through the passage.

altin-middle-west-passage.objective: Follow the passage to the next doorway
altin-middle-west-passage.text: Follow this western passage south to its next doorway.

altin-approach-frost.objective: Freeze the puddle between the ledges
altin-approach-frost.text: Use Frost on the puddle between the ledges while you are still below them. Climb the ladder only after the ice pillar is in place. Cross the pillar toward the northern doorway.

altin-approach-ice-crossing.objective: Climb and cross the ice pillar
altin-approach-ice-crossing.text: Climb the ladder to the upper ledge. Hop across the ice pillar and enter the northern doorway.

altin-third-frost.objective: Freeze the puddle by the middle ladder
altin-third-frost.text: Descend from the entrance ledge and head west. Freeze the puddle north of the middle track ladder.

altin-third-switch.objective: Flip the western switch from left to right
altin-third-switch.text: Climb the farther western ladder to reach the switch. Change the switch from left to right. Return to the middle track ladder for the ice-pillar crossing.

altin-third-statue-landed.objective: Descend from the northern cart stop
altin-third-statue-landed.text: Step off at the northern cart stop. Descend toward the statue and challenge it. Finish the reward scene before returning to the cart.

altin-third-statue.objective: Cross to the cart and ride to the statue
altin-third-statue.text: Climb the middle track ladder and cross the ice pillar. Board the cart and ride to its far stop. Descend from that stop and challenge the statue.

altin-shield-north-cart.objective: Ride back from the northern stop
altin-shield-north-cart.text: Return to the cart at the northern stop. Board it and ride back to the starting ledge. Change the track switch there before taking the chest route.

altin-shield-change-switch.objective: Change the switch back for the southern chest
altin-shield-change-switch.text: Use the farther western ladder to reach the track switch. Change it back from right to left. Return to the middle track ladder and cross the ice pillar to the cart.

altin-shield-south-cart.objective: Ride to the southern chest ledge
altin-shield-south-cart.text: Climb the middle track ladder and cross the ice pillar to the cart. Board it with the switch set back to the left. Ride to the southern stop.

altin-shield-southern-chest.objective: Open the chest east of the southern stop
altin-shield-southern-chest.text: Step off at the southern stop. Follow the ledge east and down to the chest. Open it and finish receiving the item. Retrace the ledge west and up if you want to return to the cart.

altin-dragon-shield.text: Take the cart to the southern chest ledge. From the northern statue stop, ride back to the starting ledge first. Use the farther western ladder to change the switch back from right to left. Return by the middle ladder and ice pillar, then board the cart for the southern stop. Step off and follow the ledge east and down to the chest.

altin-third-statue-exit.objective: Retreat and return through the lowest mine entrance
altin-third-statue-exit.text: Use Retreat and return to Altin. Re-enter the mine through the lowest entrance. Take the right fork to continue along the deeper route.

altin-spritz-stump.objective: Move the eastern stump one square left
altin-spritz-stump.text: Use Move to shift the stump beside the eastern puddle one square left.

altin-spritz-frost.objective: Freeze the puddle beside the moved stump
altin-spritz-frost.text: Use Frost on the eastern puddle beside the stump.

altin-spritz-switch.objective: Climb north and change the switch
altin-spritz-switch.text: Climb the northern ladder and flip the track switch. Go back south to the route across the ice pillar and moved stump. Cross to the cart and board it.

altin-spritz-east-cart.objective: Board the cart again at the eastern stop
altin-spritz-east-cart.text: Board the cart again at the eastern stop. With the northern switch already changed, this second ride reaches the western Djinni ledge. Step off there and approach the Djinni.

altin-spritz-west-landing.objective: Approach the Djinni on the western ledge
altin-spritz-west-landing.text: Step off the cart at the western stop and approach the Djinni. Finish the battle, then return to the same cart for the ride back east.

altin-spritz-cart.objective: Cross the pillar and stump to the cart
altin-spritz-cart.text: Cross the ice pillar and the stump you moved left to reach the cart. Ride to the eastern stop. Board the cart again there for the next ride. Approach the Djinni at the destination and finish the battle.

altin-spritz-cart-return.objective: Ride back east from the Djinni ledge
altin-spritz-cart-return.text: Return to the cart at the western Djinni ledge. Ride back to the eastern stop. Follow the northern return route to the puddles before climbing up to cross.

altin-spritz-exit-east-frost.objective: Freeze the puddle west of the cart route
altin-spritz-exit-east-frost.text: Use Frost on the eastern of the two puddles along the northern return route. Freeze the other puddle farther west before climbing up to cross.

altin-spritz-exit-west-frost.text: Freeze the other puddle farther west before climbing the ladder.

altin-spritz-exit.objective: Climb and cross to the northern doorway
altin-spritz-exit.text: Climb the eastern ladder to the upper ledge. Hop across the frozen puddles and go through the northern doorway.

altin-lucky-medal.objective: Open the chest in the southwest of this passage
altin-lucky-medal.text: Follow the upper passage to its southwestern chest and open it.

altin-upper-track.text: Follow the passage between its northeastern doorway and western stairway.

altin-rockfall-approach.text: Follow the long western passage south and take the stairway at its end.

altin-force-rockfall.objective: Use Force on the stump by the falling-rock sign
altin-force-rockfall.text: Follow the tunnel north to the sign and stump. Equip the Orb of Force if Force is missing from the Psynergy menu. Face the stump and use Force, then let the scene finish.

altin-descend-rockfall.objective: Descend the broken rail into the hole
altin-descend-rockfall.text: Climb down the ladder and slide to the lower level. Go to the north side of the hole. Climb down the broken track as a ladder to reach the lower cavern.

altin-hydros.objective: Follow the lower cavern to the paved area
altin-hydros.text: Follow the lower cavern west to the paved area. Heal and save before continuing north.

altin-lifting-gem.objective: Open the chest behind the statue
altin-lifting-gem.text: Let the battle and reward conversation finish. Open the chest behind the statue and finish receiving its item before returning to the blocked exit.

altin-lower-exit-rock.objective: Lift the boulder on the northern branch
altin-lower-exit-rock.text: At the forward fork, equip the Lifting Gem on a party member. Face the boulder blocking the northern doorway and use Lift. Walk underneath it into the exit passage.

altin-vial-side-route.objective: Move the western statue and enter its cave
altin-vial-side-route.text: Take the western side path off the main exit passage. Use Move on its statue to uncover the small cave entrance. Enter, open the northern chest and return south to this passage.

altin-exit-to-lama.objective: Lift the middle boulder and leave toward Lama Temple
altin-exit-to-lama.text: Take the middle path through the exit passage. Equip the Lifting Gem and use Lift on the blocking boulder. Pass underneath it and follow the western exit to the world map.

altin-lift-return-town.objective: Retreat and return through the lowest mine entrance
altin-lift-return-town.text: Use Retreat and return to town. Re-enter through the lowest mine entrance and take the forward fork toward the Lift-blocked exit.

altin-cart-route.text: Follow the tracks to the next passage. Each cart chamber has its own switch. Freeze puddles before using the ledges above them.

lamakan-vulcan-axe.text: Check the stone formation in the northwest with Reveal and open its hidden chest.

lamakan-first-desert.objective: Find water with Reveal and leave through the north opening
lamakan-first-desert.text: Use Reveal on the stone circles before entering them. Refill at the water pools. Follow the northern opening into the next desert area.

lamakan-potion.text: Reveal the stone formation in the southeastern part of this area and collect the hidden item.

lamakan-smog.objective: Reveal the half-circle near the eastern side
lamakan-smog.text: Check the half-circle of stones near the eastern side with Reveal. Approach the Djinni and finish its encounter.

lamakan-coins.objective: Reveal the stone formation west of the center
lamakan-coins.text: Reveal the stone formation west of the center of this area and open its hidden chest.

lamakan-lucky-pepper.text: Reveal the stone formation in the northwest and collect the hidden item.

lamakan-open-desert-west.text: Use the revealed pools along the way. Take the opening on the western edge into the sandfalls.

lamakan-sandfalls-first.objective: Cross west to the first hidden waterfall doorway
lamakan-sandfalls-first.text: Cross the sandfalls toward the middle of the northern wall. Use Reveal on the blocked waterfall doorway. Enter the cave.

lamakan-lower-cave.objective: Take the southern doorway back to the sandfalls
lamakan-lower-cave.text: Follow the lower cave passage to its southern doorway. Take the doorway back to the western side of the sandfalls.

lamakan-manticore.text: Head northwest through the remaining sandfalls. Heal and save. Use Reveal on the waterfall at the far western end.

lamakan-mint.objective: Reveal the formation south of the western waterfall
lamakan-mint.text: After receiving the battle rewards, Reveal the stone formation south of the western waterfall and collect the hidden item.

lamakan-final-waterfall.objective: Enter the revealed western waterfall doorway
lamakan-final-waterfall.text: Finish the battle rewards. Enter the doorway behind the final waterfall.

lamakan-upper-cave.objective: Leave through the western cave opening
lamakan-upper-cave.text: Follow the upper cave passage west. Leave through the opening to the world map.

battle.text: Finish the current battle. Location guidance resumes when you return to the field.

entrance.text: Follow the entrance passage into the sanctum's corridors.

first_jewel.objective: Search the corridors and open the chest
first_jewel.text: Search the branching corridors and open the chest. Then return to the statue with an empty eye.

first_eye.objective: Find the empty-eyed statue and use the Small Jewel
first_eye.text: Find the statue with an empty eye. Face it, open Items, select the Small Jewel and choose Use to open the passage.

move_wall.objective: Use Move on the wall statues
move_wall.text: Continue through the opened passage. Use Isaac's Move on the wall statues to uncover the hidden route behind them.

second_jewel.objective: Search beyond the movable statues for a chest
second_jewel.text: Go through the route behind the movable wall statues and open the chest. Return to the other empty-eyed statue after receiving its item.

second_eye.objective: Find the other empty-eyed statue and use the Small Jewel
second_eye.text: Find the other statue with an empty eye. Use the second Small Jewel on it to open the way deeper into the sanctum.

deeper.text: Go through the second opened passage and continue to the sun and moon chambers with Kraden.

water_first.objective: Search the corridors and open the chest
water_first.text: Explore this passage and the adjoining corridors for the unopened chest. Return to the empty-eyed statue after receiving its item.

water_second.objective: Search beyond the movable statues for a chest
water_second.text: Explore this passage and the adjoining corridors beyond the movable statues. Open the chest, then return to the other empty-eyed statue.

inspect.area: Sol Sanctum - sun and moon chambers
inspect.objective: Investigate the sun and moon chambers
inspect.text: Speak with Kraden and inspect the sun and moon chambers. Find the stairs leading to the statue puzzle above.

upstairs.area: Sol Sanctum - sun and moon chambers
upstairs.text: Go to the statue floor. Set the two outer statues onto their switches before moving the central statue; then continue with the other statue switches.

left_outer.text: Use Move to put the left outer statue onto its floor switch. Leave the central statue alone until both outer switches are activated.

right_outer.text: Use Move to put the right outer statue onto its floor switch. Both outer switches must be activated before moving the central statue.

center.text: Use Move on the central statue to complete the mechanism; both outer switches are already activated.

moon_statues.text: Move the remaining statues onto their floor switches to change the moon chamber into a sun chamber.

portal.objective: Inspect the opened wall passage downstairs
portal.text: Return to Kraden in the chamber below. Inspect the newly opened wall passage.

bags.text: Speak with Kraden and finish receiving the offered items before exploring the platforms.

venus.text: Follow the platforms to the Venus Star. Examine it and collect it in a Mythril Bag.

mercury.text: Take the Mercury Star next. Follow the newly available platforms and examine the star.

jupiter.text: Take the Jupiter Star next, then finish any conversations before continuing.

mars.text: Collect the Mars Star when the story allows it. Follow the platforms and examine the remaining star.

leave_stars.objective: Finish the Elemental Star chamber scene
leave_stars.text: Finish the chamber conversation. Continue when control returns.

escape.text: Follow the Wise One's instructions and finish the escape from Sol Sanctum.

flint.text: Walk south from Vale and approach the Djinni. Finish the conversation before continuing.

objectives.text: Follow the evacuation route and finish the current battles and conversations.

objectives.tracker: Visit the western house and enter Sol Sanctum
objectives.text: Visit the house west of town and finish the planning conversation. Follow the guarded mountain path into Sol Sanctum.

objectives.tracker: Solve the Sol Sanctum statue puzzles
objectives.text: Explore the corridors and open both chests. Use the Small Jewels at the empty-eyed statues, then complete the sun-and-moon switches.
Explore the newly opened passage. Follow the available platforms, examine each accessible pedestal and finish the conversations.

objectives.tracker: Accept the elders' quest and leave Vale
objectives.text: Accept the quest from the village elders and leave Vale with Isaac and Garet.
Before entering Sol Sanctum, move any supplies you want to keep onto Isaac or Garet.
Open the optional chest before leaving Sol Sanctum. The area cannot normally be revisited.
Finish exploring Sol Sanctum before leaving. The area cannot normally be revisited.
Before leaving Sol Sanctum, open its optional chest and check the party inventories.

objectives.tracker: Approach the Djinni south of Vale
objectives.text: Walk south from Vale and approach the Djinni on the world map. Finish its conversation.
Enter the northwest hilltop house in Vault and speak with the person inside. Investigate the inn.

objectives.tracker: Investigate the cellar beneath the roof opening
objectives.text: Use Mind Read during the inn investigation. Climb the outside ladder and enter the roof opening, then finish the cellar encounter.

objectives.tracker: Report to the mayor and reach Goma Cave
objectives.text: Speak with the mayor after the investigation. Leave Vault and travel east, then north to Goma Cave.
Search the inn in Vault for remaining items.
Speak with the mayor again after the cellar encounter and finish receiving any offered item.
Revisit the mayor after crossing Lamakan Desert and ask about the earlier investigation.
Explore the Djinni route at World map south of Vale.
Have Ivan clear the vines with Whirlwind to enter Goma Cave.
Move stumps and pillars to pass the cave and reach the eastern road.

objectives.tracker: Visit Bilibin and head toward Kolima
objectives.text: Visit Bilibin and speak with Lord McCoy. Follow the route east toward Kolima.
Approach the Djinni on the eastern ledge in Goma Cave.
Follow Bilibin's outer ledges to its hidden underground entrance.
Explore the Djinni route at Goma Cave eastern ledge.
Explore the Djinni route at Bilibin underground passage.
Enter Kolima and investigate what happened in town.

objectives.tracker: Reach Tret Tree through Kolima Forest
objectives.text: In Kolima Forest, rearrange the logs and cross to Tret Tree.
Climb through the branches of Tret Tree, using leaves and holes to descend into the inner rooms.
Heal before descending into the lowest chamber. Finish the encounter and conversation there.
Enter the eastern tree-house in Kolima from behind and follow the basement passage.
Follow the outer branches of Tret Tree to the Djinni.
Check the side chests in Kolima Forest and Tret Tree.
Explore the Djinni route at Kolima tree-house basement.
Explore the Djinni route at Tret Tree outer branches.
Travel north through Bilibin Cave to the snowfield and the town of Imil.

objectives.tracker: Visit the house and church in Imil
objectives.text: Speak with the people in the house near Imil's entrance and at the church.
Enter Mercury Lighthouse east of Imil. Approach the woman at its entrance and finish the conversation.
Explore the higher route through Bilibin Cave and open its chest.
Move the snowman from the bridge stairs to open the ice route in Imil.
Open the chest in the house near Imil's entrance before leaving for the lighthouse.
Explore the Djinni route at Imil ice cave.

objectives.tracker: Use Ply on the goddess statue
objectives.text: Use Ply while standing on the goddess statue, then follow the water-hop route.
Explore the rooms behind the waterfalls and climb to the aerie.
Heal before crossing the summit platforms. Finish the current battles and conversations.
Back at the base, fill the Empty Bottle with Hermes’ Water from the fountain.
Enter the third waterfall from the left and open the chest beyond it.
Explore the Djinni route at Mercury Lighthouse entrance route.
Explore the Djinni route at Mercury Lighthouse hidden waterfall room.
Return through Kolima Forest to the great tree.

objectives.tracker: Use Hermes' Water outside the tree
objectives.text: Face Tret outside the tree and use Hermes' Water from Items. Finish the following conversation.
Return to Kolima Bridge and finish the repair conversation. Cross when the route is restored.
Before using the water in Kolima Forest, use Move to pull the stranded tree-person onto land at Bilibin Barricade. Return afterward and speak with them.
Speak to Lord McCoy after lifting the curse and choose a chest reward.
Complete the optional barricade rescue before using the water in Kolima Forest.
At Bilibin Barricade, pull the stranded tree-person onto land with Move before using the water in Kolima Forest. Revisit afterward.
Before using the water in Kolima Forest, check the stranded tree-person at Bilibin Barricade.
Optionally visit Fuchin Temple and Master Nyunpa; Mind Read him to open the route to Fuchin Falls Cave.
Cross Mogall Forest by following the sound and movement of its tree stumps. Force makes the route much easier.

objectives.tracker: Continue through the last forest clearing
objectives.text: Heal before following the creature through the last clearing. Finish the encounter and receiving conversations before leaving.

objectives.tracker: Travel through Xian toward Alpine Crossing
objectives.text: Visit Xian and continue north toward Alpine Crossing.
Explore the side routes in Fuchin Falls Cave. Open the back-chamber chest and finish receiving its item before leaving.
If you obtain Dragon’s Eye, insert it in its statue before leaving.
Take the southwestern grass route in Mogall Forest and approach the Djinni.
In Xian, freeze the water carrier's spilled puddle and cross to the eastern cliff.
Search the small island north of Xian for the Djinni encounter.
Explore the Djinni route at Fuchin Falls Cave log route.
Explore the Djinni route at Mogall Forest southwestern grass route.
Explore the Djinni route at Xian eastern cliff.
Explore the Djinni route at World-map island north of Xian.
Explore Fuchin Falls Cave, open its back-chamber chest and speak with the temple monk before continuing.
Approach flooded Altin and enter the accessible portions of its mine.
Follow each water-spitting creature through the mine and finish its encounter. Return outside between the flooded routes.

objectives.tracker: Freeze the puddles for the mine crossings
objectives.text: Finish receiving the item after the first mine encounter. Use Frost on the puddles before climbing above them.

objectives.tracker: Explore the lower cavern and open its chest
objectives.text: Heal before entering the lower cavern's paved area. Finish the encounter and open the chest beyond it before returning to the blocked exit.
Use the cart and ice-pillar route to reach the Djinni in Altin Peak.
Return with Lift to open the earlier chest behind a boulder.
Explore the Djinni route at Altin Peak cart route.
Enter the northwestern temple at Lama Temple and finish the conversation and training.
Use Reveal on suspicious rings of stones in Lamakan Desert to find water and hidden paths.
Heal before using Reveal at the far western waterfall. Finish the encounter and continue through its doorway.
Return to Alpine Crossing with Reveal and Lift. Explore the hidden passage and raise the blocking boulder.
Reveal the half-circle of stones in Lamakan Desert and approach the Djinni.
Search the forested world-map pocket beyond Lamakan Desert for the Djinni encounter.
Explore the Djinni route at Lamakan Desert stone formation.
Explore the Djinni route at World-map forest beyond Lamakan Desert.
Return to Alpine Crossing with Reveal and Lift. Enter the hidden passage and raise the boulder.

objectives.tracker: Ask about the voyage in Kalay
objectives.text: Reach Kalay and speak to the innkeeper about the ship voyage to Tolbi.
Proceed toward Kalay Docks and the Karagol Sea.
Explore Kalay Tunnel and stop the eastern cavern's waterfall to reach its far ledge.
Return to Vault with Reveal and Frost. Ring the bell and enter the hidden cave near the graves.
Return to Vale with Lift and Reveal. Open the cave behind the western fence and explore its chest and Djinni route.
After crossing Lamakan Desert, return to Vault and speak with the mayor about the earlier investigation.
Backtracking for Vale Cave and Vault Cave is recommended before boarding.
Explore the Djinni route at Kalay Tunnel eastern waterfall cavern.
Explore the Djinni route at Vault Cave lower route.
Explore the Djinni route at Vale Cave chase route.
Revisit the mayor of Vault after crossing Lamakan Desert and ask about the earlier investigation.

objectives.tracker: Buy a ticket and board the ship
objectives.text: Buy a ticket at Kalay Docks and board the Tolbi-bound Ship.

objectives.tracker: Return the Anchor Charm to the captain
objectives.text: Retrieve the Anchor Charm from the mast and deliver it to the captain.

objectives.tracker: Defend the ship and replace its rowers
objectives.text: Deal with the voyage encounters and assign substitute rowers after each fight.
Respond to the deck calls, finish the current battles and continue the voyage. Go ashore when the ship docks.
Search the ship's storage room before docking.
Explore the optional stop if the ship lands away from Tolbi. Return aboard when ready to continue.
Search the ship's storage before docking. It cannot normally be revisited afterward.
Tolbi-bound Ship: Check all ship storage before docking.
Explore Tolbi’s shops and palace; rest in the palace if needed.
Follow the northwest dirt road from Tolbi across the western bridge to Altmiller Cave.
Grow the vine and freeze the pool outside Tolbi's south gate. Return inside and cross the ice pillar.
Approach Kalay Docks from the northern coast and explore the lower ledge.
Search the forest beyond Tolbi's western bridge for the Djinni encounter.
Explore Tolbi’s side games and Lucky Medal fountain, if desired.
Explore the Djinni route at Tolbi southern cliff route.
Explore the Djinni route at World-map forest beyond Tolbi's western bridge.
Explore the Djinni route at Northern Kalay Docks.

objectives.tracker: Find the invisible figure in Altmiller Cave
objectives.text: Investigate Altmiller Cave and find the invisible figure in its dim corridors.

objectives.tracker: Open the supply chest and return to the invisible man
objectives.text: Solve the colored-rock puzzle and open the supply chest beyond it. Finish receiving the item and return to the invisible man.
Return to Tolbi to participate in the Colosso tournament.
Use your teammates’ Psynergy at the side lanes and advance through the duels.

objectives.tracker: Speak with Babi and inspect his desk
objectives.text: Return to the palace and speak with Babi. Inspect his desk and finish receiving the offered item.
Arrange the logs and freeze the pool to reach the Djinni in Altmiller Cave.
Win all three Colosso duels and finish receiving the offered prize.
Explore the Djinni route at Altmiller Cave log chamber.
Finish all three Colosso duels, then return to the palace and finish the receiving conversations.
Main story: travel south through Gondowan Passage toward Suhalla.
For the optional Lunpa route, return through Kalay and Vault before taking the final lighthouse slide.
Enter Lunpa through the western cave. Use Cloak in shadow inside the fortress and Catch on the key through the bars. Continue through the vine, switch and box passages.
Finish the optional fortress route and its conversations before leaving Lunpa.
After leaving the fortress, return and speak with Donpa in his bedroom. Follow his directions.
Check the remaining chests in Lunpa Fortress before leaving.
Explore the Djinni route at Lunpa Fortress bedroom passage.
Explore Lunpa Fortress with Cloak and Catch. After the return journey, revisit Donpa's bedroom and follow his directions.
Follow Gondowan Passage into Suhalla and stock up for the desert.

objectives.tracker: Use Douse in the desert whirlwinds
objectives.text: Use Douse when a whirlwind catches you, then finish the encounter and continue along the path.

objectives.tracker: Continue through the desert to Suhalla Gate
objectives.text: Heal before descending the main ladder in the second desert area. Use Douse when caught and finish the encounter before continuing east.
Traverse the cliff paths and continue toward Venus Lighthouse.
Reveal the stump on the western ledge in the second desert area and cross to the lower ledge.
Explore the side cave beyond the western stump crossing. Enter the pink whirlwind without using Douse for the optional island route.
On Suhalla Gate's second cliff screen, take the third slide from the left and approach the Djinni.
Explore the Djinni route at Suhalla Desert western stump crossing.
Explore the Djinni route at Suhalla Gate third-slide route.

objectives.tracker: Reveal the hidden stairs and open the chest
objectives.text: Enter Venus Lighthouse and use Reveal on the patterned floor. Descend the hidden stairs and open the chest.
Use Carry to reach the central statue; its switching floor lights determine your later Tunnel Ruins route.
Visit Lalivero, rest if needed and speak with the townspeople.

objectives.tracker: Solve the Tunnel Ruins statue puzzle
objectives.text: Explore Babi Lighthouse, then enter the underground Tunnel Ruins and solve the colored-statue puzzle.

objectives.tracker: Reach the deeper Venus Lighthouse entrance
objectives.text: Reach the deeper entrance to Venus Lighthouse.
Follow Lalivero's outer wall and rooftop route to the northern vine.
Explore the upper slide route inside Babi Lighthouse to reach the isolated Djinni ledge.
Explore both Tunnel Ruins branches. Change the route at the Venus Lighthouse statue between visits and Reveal each branch's side-room chest.
Explore the Djinni route at Lalivero rooftops.
Explore the Djinni route at Babi Lighthouse isolated ledge.
This is an optional detour. The normal story path continues at Venus Lighthouse.

objectives.tracker: Follow the pink whirlwind route to the island
objectives.text: Return to the second desert area. Cross the revealed stump, follow the side cave and enter the pink whirlwind without using Douse.
Descend through the island’s puzzle floors using the field Psynergy collected throughout the game, including Halt and Cloak.

objectives.tracker: Explore the ship and return to the main route
objectives.text: Heal before exploring the ship at the bottom of the island dungeon. Finish the encounter and open the northern chest before returning to the main route.
Check the remaining dungeon chests and Djinni route before leaving the island.
Check the Djinn collection and finish any optional routes before taking the final lighthouse slide.
Explore the Djinni route at Crossbone Island sixth floor.
Reach the island by the pink whirlwind. Explore its puzzle floors, chests and Djinni route, then return to the main journey.
Collect all 28 Djinn, with seven of each element, before creating Clear Data.
Climb the deeper Venus Lighthouse rooms through sandfalls, Carry puzzles and switch rooms.

objectives.tracker: Open the chest in the moving-sand maze
objectives.text: Cross the moving-sand maze to the southern chest. Open it and check the party's equipment before continuing.

objectives.tracker: Heal and save before the final slide
objectives.text: Restore HP and PP and make a separate save before taking the final slide.

objectives.tracker: Cross the platforms and climb the central stairs
objectives.text: Cross the blue platforms and climb the central stairs. Finish the current battles and conversations.

objectives.tracker: Finish the ending and save Clear Data
objectives.text: Finish the dock conversations and let the ending continue. Save Clear Data when prompted.
Keep the save from before the final slide separate from later saves.
Keep a separate save from before the final lighthouse slide. Use another slot for later saves.
